About Tricker's England - Est. 1829
-----------------------------------

R.E. Tricker Limited was founded in 1829 by master shoemaker Joseph Tricker. Five generations later, his family continues to apply the same uncompromising standards of craftsmanship and traditional skills in the production of their world-renowned shoes.  
  
A reputation for outstanding manufacturing, quality and durability established Tricker’s as the maker of choice for heavy country boots and shoes for farm and estate owners to the landed gentry. These styles were later adapted for hunting, shooting and even for wear in town. Around the turn of the century, Tricker’s introduced the Jermyn Street collection and in 1925 we opened a store on London’s Jermyn Street.  
  
Unrivalled in quality, personality and character, Tricker’s footwear is to this day made entirely in our Northampton shoe factory, where we also offer full in-house bespoke, made-to-measure and repair services.  
  
Our footwear is 100% made in Northampton.  
  
We are honoured to hold a Royal Warrant bestowed by His Royal Highness, The Prince of Wales, since 1996.

About Scripps Health

Care You Can Count On  
Whether you are searching for your next career opportunity or looking for care for yourself or a family member, you’ll find what you need at Scripps. Founded in 1924 by philanthropist Ellen Browning Scripps, Scripps is a non-profit integrated health care delivery system based in San Diego, Calif. We treat more than 700,000 patients annually through the dedication of 3,000 affiliated physicians and more than 15,000 employees among our five acute-care hospital campuses, hospice and home health care services, 27 outpatient centers and clinics, and hundreds of affiliated physician offices throughout the region.  
  
Medical Excellence Every Step of the Way  
Recognized as a leader in disease and injury prevention, diagnosis and treatment, Scripps has been ranked four times as one of the nation’s best health care systems by Truven Health Analytics. Our hospitals are consistently ranked by U.S. News & World Report among the nation’s best – and Scripps is regularly recognized by Fortune, Working Mother magazine and The Advisory Board as one of the best places in the nation to work. Scripps is also at the forefront of clinical research, genomic medicine and wireless health care. With three highly respected graduate medical education programs, Scripps is a longstanding member of the Association of American Medical Colleges. More information can be found at www.scripps.org.

About Makoto Fujimura

Makoto Fujimura is a celebrated American artist known for his intricate and thought-provoking works that bridge the gap between traditional Japanese art and contemporary American aesthetics. Born in Boston, Massachusetts, Fujimura spent his formative years in both the United States and Japan, an experience that deeply influenced his perspective on culture, art, and spirituality.  
  
Fujimura's unique style is a combination of traditional Japanese Nihonga painting and modern abstract expressionism, resulting in works that are both visually stunning and deeply meaningful. His use of mineral pigments, gold leaf, and sumi ink creates a sense of depth and luminosity in his paintings, while also nodding to the rich history of Japanese art.  
  
Beyond his technical prowess, Fujimura's work is deeply rooted in his personal journey and faith. As a Christian, Fujimura draws upon themes of grace, hope, and redemption in his art, leading to pieces that often evoke a sense of contemplation and spiritual introspection. His belief in the transformative power of art is evident in his work, as he seeks to create pieces that not only captivate the eye but also challenge the soul.  
  
In addition to his artistic practice, Fujimura is also a respected writer and speaker, with several published books and numerous speaking engagements to his name. His writing often delves into the intersection of art, faith, and culture, tackling complex topics with eloquence and insight. As a thought leader in the art world, Fujimura has been instrumental in fostering conversations about the role of art in society and the spiritual impact of creative expression.  
  
Fujimura's impact goes beyond his individual works and extends to his role as a cultural influencer. As the founder of the International Arts Movement and the Fujimura Institute, he has worked to create spaces for artists to explore and engage with faith and beauty in their work. Through these initiatives, he has cultivated a community of artists who are committed to creating art that transcends mere aesthetics and speaks to deeper truths about the human experience.  
  
Throughout his career, Fujimura has garnered critical acclaim and numerous accolades for his work. He has exhibited his pieces in prestigious venues around the world, including the Tokyo National University of Fine Arts and Music, the Whitney Biennial, and the Dillon Gallery in New York. His art has also been featured in prominent collections, such as the Museum of Contemporary Art in Tokyo and the Cincinnati Museum of Art, solidifying his status as a leading figure in the contemporary art world.  
  
Ultimately, Makoto Fujimura's impact as an American artist lies not only in the beauty and complexity of his individual works but also in his role as a cultural ambassador, thought leader, and advocate for the transformative power of art. His ability to seamlessly blend diverse influences and create art that is both visually captivating and spiritually profound sets him apart as a true visionary in the world of contemporary art. With each brushstroke, Fujimura invites viewers into a world of beauty, meaning, and contemplation, challenging them to see art as a conduit for deeper understanding and connection to the world around them.

Collier County is the western gateway to the world famous Everglades. The Everglades and Big Cypress National Parks cover two thirds of the county’s total land mass and are a nature lover’s paradise. One of the largest geographical counties east of the Mississippi River, the county encompasses more than 2,000 square miles.  
  
The Collier County Board of County Commissioners, comprised of five members elected in the five different districts of the county, serves as the governing body. About 天音通信有限公司
--------------

天音通信有限公司（以下简称“天音通信”）于1996年12月正式创立，经过近18年的持续发展，现已形成三大产业集团：传统分销产业集团、移动互联产业集团和虚拟运营产业集团。其中，分销产业集团是中国最大的移动电话综合服务商之一，移动互联产业集团是中国最具潜力的移动互联网企业之一，虚拟运营产业集团则为中国首批移动通信虚拟运营商。  
  
公司目前拥有正式员工八千余名，在中国大陆地区设立了24个分公司、98个办事处、560个营销服务片区，直接覆盖并服务中国大陆5万家零售店，打造了中国规模最大的集分销、零售、售后服务、移动互联网、移动通信虚拟运营为一体的综合服务网络，其中，移动互联产业板块的塔读文学位列中国移动阅读前三强，欧朋浏览器为中国手机浏览器前四强。  
公司2013年实现营业收入367亿元人民币。从2004年开始连续11年进入中国企业500强，2014年在中国500强企业中位列第395位，在中国服务企业500强中名列第128位。多次被评为最佳雇主企业。  
  
公司秉承“客户至上，恒守诚信，以人为本，持续创新”的价值观，发扬“激情、协同、高效、执行”的企业精神，坚持“经营战略、经营员工、经营客户”的经营理念，公司未来的发展战略清新明确：以传统分销业务为基础，从渠道向网络和平台转变，打造B2B和平台商业模式，做强做大分销业务；以创新业务为抓手，整合运营商、厂商和零售商资源，全面提升综合服务能力，发展和突破移动通信虚拟运营业务；以浏览器为引擎，聚合产品和服务，构建移动互联平台，将客户变用户，扩大发展移动互联业务。  
  
在未来3-5年时间内，努力将天音通信打造成为中国最卓越的移动互联综合服务商和中国第四大移动通信运营商。

About NeoGenomics Laboratories
------------------------------

NeoGenomics Laboratories is a leading cancer diagnostic reference laboratory that has provided high-quality cancer testing and partnership programs to pathologists and oncologists for over 10 years. We work every day to achieve our common purpose of saving lives by improving patient CARE through Communication, Accuracy, Reliability, and Efficiency.  
  
Our areas of expertise include cancer cytogenetics with industry-leading turnaround times; hematologic and solid tumor FISH testing with the largest menu of technical-only services available; 10-color flow cytometry; IHC supported by an extensive antibody library; and over 100 molecular oncology tests comprising the most comprehensive combination of multiparameter profiles and targeted biomarker tests in the industry. Our technical-only testing programs feature on-demand or live training and are available to pathologists who wish to sign out FISH, flow cytometry, and/or IHC. NeoGenomics’ extremely fast test development cycle means we are highly responsive to therapy development and guideline changes, and test design always involves a balance of convention and innovation.  
  
We support clients in many cancer-related market segments, to include: hospital and private pathology laboratories, office-based oncologists, CRO / Biopharmaceutical development organizations, academic institutions / teaching hospitals, and several more.

Laila Gohar is an artist whose work defies traditional categorization. Her multidisciplinary practice spans the realms of food, sculpture, and performance, blending elements of sensory experience and cultural commentary. Born in Egypt and raised in Kuwait, Gohar’s work is deeply informed by her upbringing, as well as her experiences living and working in New York City.  
  
Gohar’s artistic process is deeply rooted in the act of gathering, whether it be ingredients for a culinary installation or found objects for a sculpture. She describes her approach as one of “assemblage,” drawing from a wide range of influences and materials to create immersive, multisensory experiences. Gohar’s work often explores themes of memory, identity, and belonging, inviting viewers to engage with the layers of meaning embedded within her creations.  
  
One of Gohar’s most well-known projects is her series of “food landscapes,” in which she arranges fruits, vegetables, and other edible items into stunning, otherworldly compositions. These ephemeral creations are often displayed in unconventional settings, such as art galleries or public spaces, challenging viewers to reconsider their relationships to food and the environments in which it is consumed. Gohar’s food landscapes are a celebration of abundance and diversity, and also serve as a commentary on the ways in which we interact with the natural world.  
  
In addition to her work with food, Gohar is also known for her sculptural installations, which often incorporate found objects and everyday materials. Her sculptures are at once playful and thought-provoking, blurring the line between art and utility. By repurposing and recontextualizing familiar objects, Gohar invites viewers to consider the ways in which their surroundings shape their experiences and perceptions.  
  
Gohar’s practice also extends to the realm of performance, as she frequently collaborates with dancers, musicians, and other artists to create immersive, interactive events. These performances often incorporate elements of food and sculpture, bringing together various sensory experiences to create a holistic, embodied art form. Gohar’s performances are a testament to her belief in the power of art to foster connections and dialogue, transcending traditional boundaries and hierarchies.  
  
Throughout her career, Gohar has garnered international acclaim for her boundary-pushing work, receiving numerous awards and commissions from prestigious institutions. Her art has been exhibited in galleries and museums around the world, and she continues to challenge and inspire audiences with her innovative, interdisciplinary approach. In a cultural moment characterized by division and uncertainty, Gohar’s work serves as a reminder of the potential of art to unite and uplift, encouraging viewers to engage with the world in new and unexpected ways.  
  
Ultimately, Laila Gohar’s art is a testament to the power of creativity to transcend boundaries and provoke thought. Through her innovative use of food, sculpture, and performance, she invites viewers to reconsider their relationships to everyday objects and experiences, fostering connections and conversations in the process. About Makoto Yukimura

Makoto Yukimura is a talented Japanese manga artist who has gained critical acclaim for his compelling storytelling and stunning artwork. Born on January 8, 1976 in Yokohama, Japan, Yukimura developed a passion for drawing and storytelling at an early age, which eventually led to his decision to pursue a career as a manga artist. He made his professional debut in 2001 with the manga series "Planetes," which garnered widespread attention for its unique blend of science fiction and human drama.  
  
Yukimura's artwork is characterized by its intricate details, expressive characters, and dynamic action scenes. His use of shading and line work creates a sense of depth and emotion in his illustrations, drawing readers into the world of his stories. In addition to his impressive artistic skills, Yukimura is also known for his ability to craft rich and complex narratives that explore themes of human resilience, morality, and the consequences of our actions.  
  
One of Yukimura's most notable works is the historical manga series "Vinland Saga," which has received global recognition for its captivating storytelling and outstanding artwork. Set in 11th-century Europe, "Vinland Saga" follows the journey of Thorfinn, a young Viking warrior seeking revenge for his father's death. As the series unfolds, Yukimura masterfully weaves together elements of historical fiction, action, and drama, creating a rich and immersive world for readers to explore.  
  
What sets "Vinland Saga" apart from other manga series is its attention to historical accuracy and its exploration of complex moral dilemmas. Yukimura delves into the harsh realities of life in the Viking Age, depicting the brutal nature of warfare, the struggles of survival, and the clash of cultures. Through his meticulous research and powerful storytelling, Yukimura brings history to life, immersing readers in a world filled with intrigue, conflict, and human drama.  
  
In addition to "Vinland Saga," Yukimura has also created other compelling works, such as "Planetes" and "Askeladd," further showcasing his versatility and creativity as a manga artist. "Planetes" is a thought-provoking science fiction series that explores the challenges of space exploration and the human desire to reach for the stars. The manga's focus on character development and existential themes resonated with readers, earning Yukimura critical acclaim and a dedicated fan base.  
  
Yukimura's "Askeladd," on the other hand, is a dark and visceral retelling of the Norse legend of King Arthur, imbued with Yukimura's trademark blend of historical accuracy and intricate character development. The series has been praised for its gripping narrative and emotional depth, cementing Yukimura's reputation as a master storyteller in the manga industry.  
  
Overall, Makoto Yukimura stands out as a remarkable talent in the world of manga, with his captivating storytelling, stunning artwork, and deep thematic explorations earning him a well-deserved place among the most respected and influential manga artists of his generation. His ability to bring history to life, probe the complexities of the human condition, and create compelling, multi-dimensional characters has cemented his status as a visionary artist whose work is celebrated by fans and critics alike. Yukimura's passion for storytelling and his dedication to his craft continue to inspire and captivate audiences around the world, making him a true powerhouse in the world of manga.

We offer the very best in personal, small business, and commercial banking products and services, including a full suite of online, mobile banking, and cash management tools. About Patricia Highsmith

Patricia Highsmith is an American novelist and short story writer best known for her psychological thrillers and suspenseful plot twists. Born in Fort Worth, Texas in 1921, Highsmith developed a fascination with human behavior and a keen eye for detail at an early age. She struggled with her personal identity and sexuality, which greatly influenced her later works. Throughout her career, Highsmith became famous for crafting morally ambiguous characters and exploring the darker aspects of human nature. Her unique writing style and complex character development have made her a revered figure in the world of crime fiction and psychological thrillers.  
  
Highsmith's most famous character, Tom Ripley, is a prime example of her ability to create multi-dimensional and morally complex protagonists. The character first appeared in Highsmith's debut novel, "The Talented Mr. Ripley," and would go on to become the central character in a series of novels. Tom Ripley is a charming, intelligent, and manipulative character who engages in morally questionable actions, yet still manages to captivate readers with his charisma and wit. Highsmith's ability to create such a compelling and complex character has earned her widespread acclaim within the literary community.  
  
In addition to her skillful character development, Highsmith's writing is characterized by its exploration of the human psyche and the intricacies of interpersonal relationships. Her novels often delve into the darker aspects of human nature, including jealousy, obsession, and the capacity for violence. Highsmith's skill in capturing the complexities of human emotion and behavior has cemented her reputation as a master of psychological suspense. Her works have been adapted into numerous acclaimed films, further solidifying her status as a literary icon.  
  
Despite her success, Highsmith led a reclusive and tumultuous personal life. She struggled with alcoholism and battled with mental illness, which often manifested in her writing. Highsmith's own experiences with internal conflict and the complexities of human nature undoubtedly informed her work, adding an extra layer of depth and authenticity to her storytelling. Her ability to tap into the depths of the human psyche and craft stories that are both psychologically astute and emotionally gripping has made her a seminal figure in the realm of crime fiction and suspense literature.  
  
Highsmith's impact on the literary world is evident in the lasting influence of her work and the continued popularity of her novels. Her ability to create morally complex characters and her keen insight into the human condition has set her apart as a truly unique and groundbreaking author. Patricia Highsmith's legacy endures as a testament to her skill in crafting compelling narratives and her unparalleled understanding of the human mind. Her contributions to the genre of psychological thrillers and crime fiction have left an indelible mark on the literary landscape, and her work continues to be celebrated and studied by readers and scholars alike.

About Beatty & Wozniak, P.C.
----------------------------

At Beatty & Wozniak, we focus on energy and natural resources law.  
  
We’ve made it a priority in our law practice to understand all segments of the conventional and emerging energy industries, including the regulatory and political contexts within which companies in these industries operate. When you walk into our office, you won’t have to educate us about the difference between a drill bit and a wind turbine. We can start discussing your problem and potential solutions right away.  
  
Our team handles a wide variety of energy litigation, title work, environmental and regulatory issues and corporate transactions. We often meet attorneys who are still learning the vocabulary of our industry while we are moving forward on the issue at hand. Right out of the gate, our knowledge and energy experience gives us a key advantage.  
  
We know you may have to work with non-industry people or face opponents, judges, juries and county commissioners who are not familiar with the energy business and may even have developed biases from a lack of understanding. We can help them see your side from an informed perspective.  
  
At Beatty & Wozniak, we think and speak energy 24 hours a day. Just like our clients.

Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, Mead Johnson Nutrition is the only global company focused primarily on pediatric nutrition. We operate in a growing and vital industry, bringing to market a broad portfolio of leading brands and more than 70 products, from infant formulas to growing-up milks.  
  
We offer a variety of exciting career options, with opportunities ranging from research and development, sales, and marketing to manufacturing and finance. Our 6,800 team members – operating in more than 50 countries – adhere to a set of values that includes the passionate pursuit of continuous improvement; an uncompromising commitment to scientific rigor and quality; maintaining integrity in every relationship we create; and establishing an environment of openness, respect and high performance.

About Takeda Oncology
---------------------

Takeda Oncology, the Global Oncology Business Unit of Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited, is structured to ensure a tight connection from research to development to commercialization and rapidly meet the needs of the cancer community, optimizing our ability to bring transformative medicines to market. Built on a legacy foundation and structured for agility, our leaders have proven experience to drive future growth.  
  
We’ve demonstrated leadership in the treatment of hematologic cancers and solid tumors, and we’re now leveraging that expertise to advance cutting-edge science through multiple platforms, partnerships and therapeutic approaches. We are focused on collaborating with leading scientific teams around the globe to accelerate remarkable innovation, including by leveraging the power of innate immunity to enhance and broaden the impact of immunotherapy.  
  
We complement our deep in-house expertise with a network of symbiotic external partnerships to unlock the most promising science wherever it emerges. We fuel our relationships with academic, biotechnology and pharmaceutical partners with mutual respect, shared knowledge, scientific rigor and agility to find the best way to attack cancer.  
  
Takeda Oncology: We aspire to cure cancer, with inspiration from patients and innovation from everywhere.  
  
For more information, visit www.takedaoncology.com. If you are interested in learning more about current career opportunities, please visit the Takeda Pharmaceuticals Career Page.

Our mission is to achieve our vision by conducting the duties in highly ethical environment and providing ClinSync services with honesty, quality and compliance to our clients, stake holders and employees; We also advocate the clinicians, researchers and patients in best possible ethical ways to expedite the development of new medicines and/or technologies that alleviate suffering of the patients. \-Protocol finalized  
\-Project team located

Equitable Bank provides a variety of personal banking accounts, including checking and savings accounts. Each account type is designed to offer convenience and flexibility, with features like online banking, mobile access, and the ability to set up online bill pay.

Equitable Bank is committed to supporting local businesses through a range of business lending solutions. Equitable Bank's online bill pay service offers several benefits, including convenience, time savings, and enhanced control over your finances. The benefits include tax deductions on contributions, tax-free growth on earnings, and tax-free withdrawals for eligible healthcare costs, making it an effective way to manage healthcare expenses.

What mobile banking features does Equitable Bank provide?

Equitable Bank offers a comprehensive mobile banking platform that allows customers to manage their accounts on the go. Mintz Group is a corporate investigations firm that gathers information before hiring, before transactions, during litigation disputes and after frauds, all over the world.  
  
Clarity in a Complex World  
  
It’s tricky doing business in a complex, cross-border environment. When the truth is complicated and hidden, we find what you need to know to make informed decisions in business relationships, in the workplace and in court. We specialize in one thing: Digging into questions that concern our clients.

We’re the only corporate investigations firm that has thought through background checking from A to Z. Literally. We help litigators -- across all practice areas -- find admissible evidence hidden along obscure paper trails and in the memories of apprehensive witnesses. Many of our investigations end with the tracing and recovery of opponents'​ assets.  
  
► Fraud Investigations  
Mintz Group conducts a variety of investigations on behalf of clients who believe they have been victims of fraud. And we regularly assist counsel with anti-corruption (FCPA, etc.) investigations.

About Devon Energy

Devon Energy Corporation is a leading independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company. Devon's operations are focused onshore in the United States.  
  
The company's portfolio of oil and gas properties provides stable, environmentally responsible production and a platform for future growth. Currently, the company produces approximately 140,000 barrels of oil per day and has a deep inventory of development opportunities to deliver future growth. Devon also produces about 575 million cubic feet of natural gas a day and about 80,000 barrels of natural gas liquids per day.  
  
Devon is focused on the following strategic priorities intended to optimize returns and deliver top-tier, capital-efficient cash-flow growth:  
  
\- Maximize cash flow by optimizing base production and reducing per-unit cash costs  
\- Improve capital efficiency with a concentration of investment on the highest-returning development projects  
\- Simplify our portfolio by monetizing non-core assets

About Fort Point Beer Company
-----------------------------

Fort Point Beer Company is a New American brewery - the product of a thriving American craft beer culture, shaped by deeply San Franciscan values: quality craftsmanship and a spirit of innovation. We create balanced, thoughtful beers that reference traditional styles but are by no means bound to them. For us, brewing is the confluence of creative expression and refined technique. We want our beers to tell a story, inspire an idea, and be thoroughly enjoyable.  
  
Fort Point Beer Company was founded in 2014 by brothers Tyler and Justin Catalana in the Presidio of San Francisco. The brewery resides in an historic Presidio building that was formerly used as an Army motor pool. Being situated in this iconic landscape reinforces our pride in San Francisco and in the beer we brew. Head Brewer Mike Schnebeck has developed a deft and impassioned brewing style over the past years at Mill Valley Beerworks and leads the pioneering spirit of our beers.

About Adore Me
--------------

At Adore Me we take on seemingly impossible challenges. In 2011, we were founded to solve a single problem: help women buy bras online. It might seem like a simple task, but a bra is one of the most complex and personal garments in existence. What types of laser hair removal services do you offer?

Laser Clinics Australia specializes in a variety of laser hair removal services suitable for all skin types. We utilize advanced technology to provide effective treatments for areas including the face, legs, arms, underarms, and bikini line. Our trained professionals assess your individual needs to create a personalized treatment plan that ensures optimal results.

Are your skin treatments suitable for all skin types?

Yes, our skin treatments are designed to cater to a wide range of skin types and concerns. We offer services such as skin rejuvenation, acne treatment, and pigmentation removal using state-of-the-art technology. During your consultation, our experienced staff will evaluate your skin condition and recommend the most suitable treatment options for you.

What are cosmetic injections, and how do they work?

Cosmetic injections, such as anti-wrinkle treatments and dermal fillers, are non-surgical procedures aimed at enhancing facial aesthetics. Anti-wrinkle injections work by temporarily relaxing facial muscles to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, while dermal fillers add volume to areas like lips and cheeks. Our qualified practitioners ensure that each treatment is tailored to your specific goals for a natural-looking result.

How does CoolSculpting work, and is it safe?

CoolSculpting is a non-invasive fat reduction treatment that uses controlled cooling to target and eliminate stubborn fat cells. The procedure is FDA-cleared and has been proven to be safe and effective. During the treatment, a cooling applicator is applied to the targeted area, freezing fat cells without harming surrounding tissue. Results can be seen over time as the body naturally processes and eliminates the treated fat cells.

What products do you recommend for at-home skin care?

At Laser Clinics Australia, we recommend Skinstitut products for at-home skin care. These products are formulated with high-quality ingredients to complement our in-clinic treatments. Our skin care professionals can provide personalized recommendations based on your skin type and concerns to help you maintain and enhance your results.

How can I find a Laser Clinics Australia location near me?

With over 200 clinics across Australia, finding a Laser Clinics location near you is easy. You can visit our website and use the 'Find a Clinic' feature, where you can enter your postcode or city to see the nearest clinics. Each clinic provides a range of services, and you can also book a consultation online.

About shareMAG
--------------

Wir teilen auf sharemag.de eine gemeinsame Vision: Sharing. Wir glauben, dass Sharing in seinen unterschiedlichsten Ausprägungen die Zukunft gehört. Deshalb wollen wir allen, die genauso denken eine Plattform bieten. Wir sehen Sharing als einen weit gefassten Begriff, der sowohl soziale als auch wirtschaftliche Aspekte einbezieht – oftmals in Verbindung mit Werten wie Nachhaltigkeit, Fairness und Regionalität. Das Themenspektrum reicht von regional basierten Food- und Bekleidungs-Sharing Initiativen, über Nachbarschafts- Sharing bis hin zu gewinnorientierten Geschäftsmodellen wie Car-, Appartement. oder Music-Sharing. All das interessiert uns. All das findet statt auf unserer Plattform. Auf sharemag.de präsentieren wir Protagonisten, Ideen und Konzepte aus der Welt des Sharings und freuen uns über Leserbeiträge, Reaktionen und Visionen. Wir wollen rund um das Thema Sharing inspirieren, diskutieren, manches hinterfragen und bei einigen Dingen näher hinschauen. Um damit insgesamt dazu beizutragen, dass diese Form des nachhaltigen Wirtschaftens weiterwächst. Als ein Wirtschaftsunternehmen tragen wir unseren Teil dazu schon seit über 111 Jahren erfolgreich bei und wissen aus erster Hand um die Kraft, die Chancen und die Zukunftsfähigkeit des Sharing-Modells. About VARTA Microbatteries & Solutions
--------------------------------------

VARTA AG produces and markets a comprehensive battery portfolio, ranging from microbatteries, household batteries, energy storage systems to customer-specific battery solutions for a wide range of applications. As the parent company of the Group, it operates in the business segments “Lithium-Ion Solutions” & “Microbatteries and Household Batteries”.

About Distek, Inc.
------------------

Distek is a leading manufacturer of laboratory testing instruments for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry for more than 45 years, as well as an experienced provider of validation and qualification services.  
  
Distek engineers highly innovative, technically modern and user-friendly instruments that provide many innovative features to customers, worldwide. These include: water bath and bathless dissolution, media preparation (heating, degassing and dispensing) and disposal, in-situ fiber optic UV, bathless tablet disintegration, content uniformity and dissolution autosampling. Distek’s bioprocessing portfolio includes the BIOne single-use bioreactor for cell culture applications as well as the BIOne 1250, an innovative bioreactor control system for both mammalian and microbial models.  
  
Distek’s core market includes brand name, generic and biosimilar drug manufacturers, CRO’s, CMO’s, Nutraceuticals, government agencies and universities. Distek holds several instrumentation and accessory patents and has been ISO certified since 2002.

What types of laboratory testing instruments does Distek, Inc. manufacture?

Distek, Inc. specializes in manufacturing a wide range of laboratory testing instruments primarily for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. Their product line includes dissolution testing systems, automated sampling systems, and benchtop bioreactors. Additionally, they offer innovative solutions such as bathless disintegration and in-situ fiber optic UV dissolution systems, designed to enhance efficiency and accuracy in laboratory testing.

What validation services does Distek, Inc. provide?

Distek, Inc. offers comprehensive validation and qualification services to ensure that laboratory instruments and processes meet regulatory standards. Their services include Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ). These services are crucial for pharmaceutical companies to maintain compliance with FDA and other regulatory bodies, ensuring that their testing processes are reliable and reproducible.

How does Distek, Inc. support the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries?

Distek, Inc. supports the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries by providing high-quality laboratory testing instruments and validation services that are essential for drug development and quality control. Their solutions are designed to meet the specific needs of these industries, helping companies ensure product safety, efficacy, and compliance with stringent regulatory requirements. With over 45 years of experience, Distek is a trusted partner for organizations looking to optimize their laboratory operations.

What is the advantage of using bathless dissolution systems offered by Distek, Inc.?

Bathless dissolution systems from Distek, Inc. offer several advantages over traditional water bath systems. These systems provide precise temperature control, reduce the risk of contamination, and minimize the need for extensive maintenance. Additionally, bathless systems can improve the efficiency of dissolution testing by allowing for faster setup and easier cleaning. This innovative technology is particularly beneficial for laboratories looking to enhance productivity while maintaining high standards of accuracy.

Can Distek, Inc. assist with the preparation of dissolution media?

Yes, Distek, Inc. provides solutions for dissolution media preparation, which is a critical step in the dissolution testing process. Their instruments are designed to facilitate the accurate and consistent preparation of dissolution media, ensuring that the testing conditions are optimal for evaluating the release of active pharmaceutical ingredients. This capability is essential for laboratories aiming to achieve reliable and reproducible results in their dissolution testing.

What are single-use bioreactors, and how does Distek, Inc. utilize them?

Single-use bioreactors are innovative systems designed for cell culture and fermentation processes in biopharmaceutical production. Distek, Inc. offers single-use bioreactors that provide flexibility, reduce cross-contamination risks, and streamline the manufacturing process. These bioreactors are ideal for small-scale production and research applications, allowing for efficient experimentation and development of biopharmaceutical products without the need for extensive cleaning and validation associated with traditional reusable systems.

Susan Weber is an accomplished American historian with a passion for uncovering the untold stories of the past. Born and raised in New York City, Weber developed a love for history at a young age. She was drawn to the stories of the city's rich and diverse past, and this early fascination eventually led her to pursue a career in the field of history. After earning a bachelor's degree in history from Columbia University, she went on to complete a master's degree at Harvard University, where she honed her research and writing skills under the guidance of some of the most respected historians in the field.  
  
Weber's work as a historian has taken her all over the world, allowing her to delve into a wide range of historical topics and periods. Her book, "Across the Waters: A History of Immigration to America," examines the diverse experiences of immigrants who have come to the United States from around the world, from the early colonial period to the present day. Through her research, Weber has highlighted the ways in which immigration has shaped American society and culture, bringing together people from different backgrounds and creating a vibrant tapestry of diversity.  
  
Weber's passion for history is evident in her engaging writing style and her ability to connect with readers. Whether she is exploring the experiences of women during the American Revolution or delving into the complexities of immigration, Weber's work is characterized by its depth, nuance, and empathy, inviting readers to see the past in a new light.  
  
As a historian, Susan Weber has not only expanded our knowledge of the past but also challenged us to reconsider our understanding of history. Her work has highlighted the voices and experiences of those who have been marginalized or overlooked, enriching our understanding of the complexities and contradictions of the human experience. With offices in Houston, Austin, Dallas, and Washington, D.C., we look for team members who want to work in a challenging environment in which excellence is both expected and rewarded.

-----------------------------

We are a leading provider of business support and finance in the South East and East of England, helping to create jobs in communities and grow the local economy.  
  
We are an award-winning social enterprise which means that we were established to help people and businesses to achieve their dreams. We are proud to deliver high-quality, independent advice to businesses either looking to start or established businesses looking to take their next step and grow.  
  
We work closely with Local Authorities, Government, and Partner organisations to deliver contracts that support the business community, stimulating the local economy and creating jobs.  
  
Our Let's Do Business Finance service focuses on delivering business loans to start-ups and established companies looking to grow. As an official delivery partner of The Start-Up Loan Company, we provide start-up loans up to £25,000 to help people to take the plunge into starting their own business. About Lash Group
----------------

Lash Group, a part of AmerisourceBergen, is a patient support services company. At Lash Group, we work with purpose. As a member of our team, you’ll have an opportunity to learn, work and grow alongside highly motivated associates who genuinely want to make a difference and put patients at the center of everything they do. This patient-centricity is an ethos that lies in the heart of each and every one of our associates. It’s what drives us to help patients gain access, afford and stay adherent to vital therapies. We’re looking for high performers who embrace change, welcome new technology, and are motivated to make an impact on people’s lives. As our fast-paced industry grows and evolves so does the need for our company to gain and retain top talent. If you're seeking a career opportunity that offers great perks and an even greater purpose, we're looking for you.  
  
Lash Group employs more than 3,000 associates across five offices located throughout the country, and in 2016, our headquarters in Fort Mill was named to the list for "Best Places to Work in South Carolina"​ by the South Carolina Chamber of Commerce and SCBiz magazine. Our associates represent many different educational backgrounds and professional experiences. But everyone, from those just entering the workforce, to registered nurses and business managers with decades of experience, is committed to improving patients’ lives in an industry that is ever-changing and evolving. We accomplish this through four key services: reimbursement support, co-pay assistance, patient assistance, and adherence services. Each day our associates use technology and excellent communication skills as they work closely with key industry stakeholders to help patients access – and stay on – treatment. And because the healthcare industry is very dynamic, associates always have opportunities to learn and apply new skills.

The College of Legal Practice, headquartered in London, is a pioneering institution dedicated to providing practice-based legal education tailored to the evolving needs of aspiring solicitors. The College is fully accredited and offers a range of highly flexible postgraduate programs, including preparation courses for the Solicitors Qualifying Examination (SQE) and an LLM in Legal Practice.  
  
With a strong commitment to increasing access to the legal profession, The College of Legal Practice designs its courses to accommodate diverse career pathways, ensuring that students from various backgrounds can pursue their ambitions in law. The College's innovative approach includes intensive, purpose-built virtual training programs that equip students with the practical skills and knowledge necessary to excel in today’s competitive legal landscape.  
  
In addition to its comprehensive curriculum, The College of Legal Practice boasts a distinguished faculty comprised of experienced legal professionals who are dedicated to fostering a supportive learning environment. Prospective students often seek information about the College's educators, leading to queries such as "The College Of Legal Practice teachers list." This reflects the institution's emphasis on high-quality instruction and mentorship, which are critical components of its practice-led educational model. Overall, The College of Legal Practice stands out as a leading provider of legal education in the UK, committed to shaping the next generation of solicitors equipped for the challenges of modern legal practice.

The challenge confronting many athletes is how to maintain a balance between sport and the rest of their lives. The PD program aims to support athletes in achieving this balance without compromising their sporting goals, offering a range of support and services relating to the key areas of the program. So we staff our labs, manufacturing suites and packaging facilities with pharmaceutical specialists and equip them with technology from the most-respected manufacturers in the pharmaceutical industry – innovators in life-science equipment.  
  
The RPS drug development process is supported by a fully integrated system of quality and reliability. Each project is managed by a multi-disciplinary team – specialists dedicated to the success of your drug candidate. Recognizing the importance of transparency and open communication, we provide you with secure access to a client portal, so you can manage business in real time, when and where you want. As a result, you can outsource to RPS without feeling as if you’re relinquishing control.  
  
You can turn to RPS at any stage. Our breadth of offerings ensures a seamless process and allows you to focus on your core competencies.  
  
Celebrating our 40th anniversary, RPS operates facilities in Montreal, Canada and Long Island, New York – 340,000 sq. ft. of cGMP-compliant, FDA-inspected and Health Canada-certified space, licensed for controlled substance management and equipped with level 9 security and ample cold-storage locations.  
  
With dedicated teams, state-of- the-art facilities, agility to meet your unique needs and open communication, RPS is the trusted partner for your next solid oral dosage project.

Genesis ATS is an equipment and service provider to Fortune 500 and major carrier customers in the US and internationally. Genesis ATS "lifecycle" approach starts by providing new, pre-owned and surplus IP network, telecom and mobility equipment from the world's leading OEMs. Next, Genesis ATS provides true lifecycle management solutions, from install/decommission, logistics support, field engineering and network transformation services, to IntelliNet™, the intelligent alternative to OEM sparing & maintenance programs. Finally, Genesis ATS closes the loop with specialized asset valuation & recovery and disposal/recycling services, ensuring maximum financial return on excess network assets or disposal according to the highest international standards.  
  
Genesis ATS also partners with leading OEMs and carriers to provide end-to-end mobile device management solutions, including device and data plan procurement, complex staging & kitting services and advanced exchange/warranty replacement programs designed to support your growing mobile workforce.

About Suni Lee

Suni Lee - American Gymnast  
  
Suni Lee, the rising star of American gymnastics, captivates audiences with her graceful athleticism and unwavering determination. Born on March 9, 2003, to a Hmong-American family in St. Paul, Minnesota, Sunisa "Suni" Lee's journey to Olympic greatness is an inspiring testament to her resilience and unyielding spirit.  
  
From a young age, Suni showed exceptional talent and passion for gymnastics. She began training at the age of six, inspired by watching her older brother compete in the sport. With each practice session, it became evident that Suni possessed rare qualities that could take her to the highest levels of gymnastics.  
  
As Suni's skills developed, so did her reputation within the gymnastics community. Coaches and teammates marveled at her strength, flexibility, and natural gymnastic instincts. Her routines were elegant and precise, showcasing her ability to seamlessly blend power and grace. It wasn't long before Suni's name began to appear among the top contenders in national and international competitions.  
  
However, Suni's rise to prominence was not without significant obstacles. In 2019, just before the U.S. Gymnastics Championships, tragedy struck when her father, John Lee, fell from a ladder while at work, suffering a severe spinal cord injury that left him paralyzed from the chest down. This devastating event shook Suni and her family to their core, threatening to derail her gymnastics dreams.  
  
Yet, despite the immense emotional and physical toll, Suni persevered. She dedicated her performances to her father, finding solace and strength in the sport that had always been her refuge. Suni's remarkable ability to compartmentalize her pain and focus on her gymnastics allowed her to place second in the all-around competition at the U.S. Gymnastics Championships, securing her a spot on the U.S. national team.  
  
The pinnacle of Suni's career came in 2021 at the Tokyo Olympics. With her sights set on victory, she displayed a stunning performance, showcasing her incredible skills on the bars, beam, floor, and vault. Her routines were executed flawlessly, captivating the judges and spectators alike. Suni's signature move, a complex and daring bar routine that includes multiple release moves, was a testament to her technical prowess and fearless approach.  
  
In the individual all-around final, Suni once again showcased her resolve and unshakeable focus. Despite intense competition from gymnastics powerhouses such as Simone Biles and Rebeca Andrade, Suni stayed steady and composed, seizing the opportunity to win the gold medal. Her electrifying floor routine and stunning dismounts on the balance beam earned her a well-deserved place in gymnastics history.  
  
Beyond her extraordinary talent, Suni's success is a testament to her cultural heritage and the pride she brings to the Hmong community. As the first Hmong-American to represent the United States in the Olympics, Suni has become a role model for aspiring athletes worldwide, especially those from underrepresented backgrounds.  
  
Suni's triumphs extend far beyond the gymnasium. She has used her platform to raise awareness about her father's condition and advocate for the disabled community. Suni's unwavering devotion to her family and her ability to overcome adversity has endeared her to millions around the world, who see her not just as a gymnastics icon, but as a symbol of resilience and determination.  
  
As she continues to defy expectations and shatter barriers, all eyes are on Suni Lee as she prepares for future competitions. With her unparalleled talent, fierce determination, and unyielding spirit, Suni's journey in gymnastics is only just beginning. She has become a beacon of inspiration, reminding us all that with hard work, passion, and an unwavering belief in oneself, anything is possible.

About SOS Beauty Group
----------------------

SOS Beauty Group, headquartered in the heart of Beverly Hills, California, is a premier player in the luxury beauty industry, dedicated to nurturing and elevating innovative beauty brands. With decades of industry experience, SOS Beauty Group prides itself on its comprehensive approach to brand development, management, and marketing. The company collaborates closely with a diverse array of artists, entrepreneurs, and beauty visionaries from around the globe, ensuring that each concept is meticulously crafted from inception to retail launch.  
  
At SOS Beauty Group, the focus is on creating standout luxury beauty products that resonate with consumers and set trends in the market. The firm offers a wide range of services, including brand strategy, product development, packaging design, and go-to-market strategies, all tailored to meet the unique needs of each client. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and market insights, SOS Beauty Group empowers its partners to navigate the complexities of the beauty landscape, ensuring their brands not only thrive but also captivate audiences.  
  
The industries served by SOS Beauty Group extend beyond traditional beauty, encompassing skincare, cosmetics, haircare, and wellness, reflecting the evolving nature of consumer preferences. With a commitment to quality and innovation, SOS Beauty Group is at the forefront of the luxury beauty sector, transforming visionary ideas into successful brands that are celebrated worldwide. Whether it's through strategic partnerships or creative collaborations, SOS Beauty Group is dedicated to shaping the future of beauty, one brand at a time.

ZCOM Systems Group Inc (aka ZCOM) is an independent Systems Integration services provider. We serve both small and large enterprise clients globally. Our customers range from telecommunication service providers to local main street businesses. We have a uniquely talented pool of IT professionals with extensive hands-on experience and a credible track record of references. We cover the full IT Lifecycle from Strategy and Architecture, to Systems Support and Application Maintenance.  
  
  
ZCOM operates out of centers of excellence around the world with an extensive bias for active on-site presence with our customers. Our teams are composed of industry veterans that understand the varied needs of businesses large and small. We understand your business and are talented in mapping IT solutions to business problems and opportunities.  
  
Our teams are composed of seasoned veterans with deep experience, balanced with a mix of cost-effective junior staff. We draw from our extensive network to quickly staff up your projects with local and offshore resources.

We were the first to market metadata-driven software in the Inventory, Catalog and Order Management domains. We were the first with “Catalog Driven Order Management” solutions. These concepts have now been widely adopted by the industry and its suppliers, helping to transform the industry.  
  
Our legacy includes ConceptWave Software Inc., acquired by Ericsson AB in 2012, and Objectel Software Inc., now owned by Oracle Corp. Both product portfolios remain key components of these vendor's portfolios and are deployed globally in the largest operators. They have stood the test of time.

MSD – zorgen voor gezondheid  
  
Je gezondheid heeft aandacht nodig. Bescherming en zorg. Samen met zorgverleners, beleidsmakers en verzekeraars zijn wij er om je daarmee te steunen.  
Wij zijn MSD. We bieden patiënten én zorgverleners innovatieve geneesmiddelen die het verschil kunnen maken tussen ziek op bed liggen én de gewone, dagelijkse dingen doen. Soms zelfs tussen leven en dood.  
  
Wij zijn actief op tal van gebieden. En zoeken continu nieuwe oplossingen voor ziektes waar nog geen antwoord op is. Altijd met aandacht voor de juiste patiënt op het juiste moment.  
We ontwikkelen ook slimme oplossingen om medicatie optimaal in te zetten. Zodat we mensen helpen en tegelijkertijd verspilling tegengaan. Waardoor geneesmiddelen effectiever, veiliger én doelmatiger gebruikt kunnen worden.  
  
We zoeken actief de samenwerking en dialoog met partners in de zorg om toekomstbestendige zorg te realiseren die aansluit bij de gezamenlijke behoefte. Door onze geneesmiddelen en oplossingen op maat maken wij het mogelijk om jullie waarde propositie richting andere zorgpartners te optimaliseren.  
  
Zo zorgen we samen voor de gezondheid van miljoenen mensen in Nederland. Want onze gezondheid is het meest dierbare wat er is.  
  
Wij zijn MSD. Wij zorgen voor gezondheid. Samen met jou.

About Seton Hill University
---------------------------

Seton Hill University, located in Greensburg, Pennsylvania, is a distinguished Catholic coeducational liberal arts institution founded by the Sisters of Charity. With a commitment to inclusivity, Seton Hill welcomes students of all faiths and backgrounds, fostering a diverse learning environment just 35 miles from Pittsburgh. The university serves over 2,000 students, equipping them to “think and act critically, creatively, and ethically” as they prepare to make meaningful contributions to society.  
  
Seton Hill offers a robust liberal arts education complemented by specialized study in various fields, boasting an impressive 98% career placement rate for graduates. The university provides more than 80 undergraduate programs, along with accelerated and online bachelor’s degrees for adult learners, as well as master’s and doctorate programs. Students can choose from five schools of study: Business, Natural and Health Sciences, Humanities, Education and Applied Social Sciences, and Visual and Performing Arts.  
  
The university prides itself on personalized support, with small class sizes that foster close relationships between students and faculty, allowing for tailored guidance and mentorship. This supportive environment extends beyond graduation, offering alumni unlimited access to career and professional development services at no additional cost. Notable academic majors include Medical Studies, Business Management, Psychology, and Exercise Science, reflecting Seton Hill's dedication to preparing students for success in their chosen careers. For those interested in the academic landscape, a comprehensive Seton Hill University teachers list is available, showcasing the experienced faculty committed to student success.

About Tutors for All
--------------------

Fewer than 2 in 10 students who enter 9th grade in Boston schools ever graduate college. We envision a community where resources are aligned to ensure all school-aged children have a strong foundation with the skills and knowledge to pursue their personal and professional dreams.  
  
A fiscally sponsored program of Third Sector New England (TSNE), Tutors for All (T4A) bridges the achievement gap one student at a time. Through bringing together colleges, schools and community resources, we offer underserved students the systematic individualized instruction they need in order to thrive. Students in the Tutors for All programs have shown dramatically improved MCAS scores and renewed and deeper confidence in their academic abilities. Schools hosting Tutors for All programs have seen assessment results rise from below Boston averages to above state averages. For more information regarding Tutors for All, visit our website at www.tutorsforall.org

### Frequently Asked Questions about Tutors for All

What services does Tutors for All provide to students?

Tutors for All offers individualized education services designed to meet the unique needs of each student. Our primary focus is on enhancing basic math and literacy skills, preparing students for the MCAS (Massachusetts Comprehensive Assessment System), and fostering an academic mindset that encourages lifelong learning. We work with students in various grade levels, ensuring they receive the support necessary to succeed academically.

How does Tutors for All tailor its tutoring programs to individual students?

At Tutors for All, we believe that every student learns differently. Our approach begins with an initial assessment to identify each student's strengths and areas for improvement. Based on this assessment, we develop a customized tutoring plan that aligns with the student's learning style and academic goals. Our tutors are trained to adapt their teaching methods to ensure that each student receives the most effective support possible.

What qualifications do Tutors for All tutors have?

Our tutors come from diverse educational backgrounds and possess a strong commitment to student success. Many of our tutors are current or former educators, graduate students, or professionals with expertise in specific subjects. All tutors undergo a rigorous selection process, including background checks and training in our individualized education approach, to ensure they are well-equipped to support students effectively.

How can parents get involved with Tutors for All?

Parents play a crucial role in their child's education, and we encourage their involvement at Tutors for All. Parents can participate by communicating openly with tutors about their child's progress, attending workshops and informational sessions we offer, and providing feedback to help us improve our services. Additionally, we welcome parents to volunteer or contribute to our community initiatives aimed at enhancing educational resources for all students.

What is the impact of Tutors for All on student graduation rates?

Tutors for All is dedicated to improving educational outcomes for students in Boston, particularly those at risk of not graduating. By providing personalized tutoring and support, we aim to equip students with the skills and confidence they need to succeed in high school and beyond. Our data shows that students who participate in our programs demonstrate significant improvements in their academic performance, which contributes to higher graduation rates and better preparedness for college.

What subjects and grade levels does Tutors for All cover?

Tutors for All primarily focuses on basic math and literacy skills instruction, as well as MCAS preparation. We cater to students from elementary through high school, ensuring that we address the specific academic needs of each grade level. Our programs are designed to support students in building foundational skills that are critical for their overall academic success and future educational endeavors.

About College Of American Pathologists (CAP)
--------------------------------------------

The College of American Pathologists (CAP) is the premier organization of board-certified pathologists dedicated to fostering and advocating excellence in the practice of pathology and laboratory medicine worldwide. How we work together is just as important as what we do, and the CAP's workplace culture aligns under our Leadership Values: Partnership, Respect, Accountability, Communication, and Excellence.  
  
Working in close collaboration with leading pathologists from across the country and other talented colleagues, CAP staff play a crucial role in advancing the specialty and making people healthier. You'll enjoy being part of a team of people who truly care about their work, constantly seeking new ways to learn and grow.  
  
If you are looking to make a meaningful impact in the field of pathology and laboratory medicine, and ultimately the lives of patients, we invite you to join us and help shape the future of health care.  
  
The CAP is a 501(c)(6) membership organization recognized as the gold standard in laboratory accreditation, with nearly 8,000 laboratories worldwide accredited by CAP. The majority of the CAP's roughly 600 employees are based at the organization's headquarters in suburban Chicago (Northfield, Illinois), with around 30 staff members working at the Washington, DC satellite office.

About JSR Associates, Inc.
--------------------------

JSR Associates, Inc., a small woman-owned business, was started in 1996, by founder Jane Rohde. The mission of the company is based upon the philosophy that design for seniors begins by supporting operations and care models. The built environment, in turn, provides opportunities for improving resident outcomes, promoting independence, and sustaining dignity and purpose.  
  
JSR Associates, Inc. has provided senior living consulting services for projects that are evaluating and repositioning their continuing care retirement communities (CCRC), adult living communities, assisted living projects, and skilled nursing projects around the country. The goal during strategic master planning is to overlay the existing plan and concepts with current trends in senior living, reimbursements, staff needs and operational function, culture change, and care models to meet the future needs of current residents, as well as the next generation of residents.  
  
Pre-design services; including focus groups, existing community site evaluation, master planning and programming services are all tools used during the recommended strategic master planning process. This process has been successful for several clients, including for-profit and non-profit developers and government agencies, to position their projects for the future. JSR often purposefully collaborates with local design and planning firms to provide the best overall senior living knowledge base in conjunction with familiarity with local code, agency, regulation, and demographic information.

About The Wright Center For Graduate Medical Education
------------------------------------------------------

The Wright Center for Graduate Medical Education, headquartered at 111 North Washington Avenue in Scranton, Pennsylvania, is dedicated to reshaping the landscape of medical training through its innovative residency and fellowship programs. With a focus on Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, and Psychiatry, as well as specialized fellowships in Cardiovascular Disease and Gastroenterology, The Wright Center empowers its residents to become agile leaders and innovators in healthcare. This non-profit Graduate Medical Education Safety-Net Consortium immerses trainees in diverse community settings across Luzerne, Lackawanna, Wayne, and Pike counties, fostering a commitment to serving underrepresented populations.  
  
Aligned with the national Beyond Flexner movement, The Wright Center emphasizes the importance of training community-minded health professionals who are equipped to address healthcare disparities. The strong affiliations with organizations such as Commonwealth Health System, the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, and Geisinger enhance the educational experience, providing residents with access to a wide range of learning environments, including Maternal and Family Health Services and Scranton Primary Health Care Center.  
  
Additionally, The Wright Center's National Family Medicine Residency (NFMR) program extends its reach across the United States, with learners training at Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) in locations such as Tucson, Arizona, and Washington, D.C. This consortium model not only supports the NFMR learners but also integrates the educational resources of AT Still University School of Osteopathic Medicine, ensuring a comprehensive training experience. For those interested in the teaching faculty, The Wright Center for Graduate Medical Education offers a diverse and experienced teachers list, reflecting its commitment to excellence in medical education and community health.

About Parker Wright

Parker Wright is an accomplished Power Engineer at Pepco Holdings, where he plays a pivotal role in advancing the utility infrastructure through innovative engineering solutions. With a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Delaware, Parker brings a wealth of expertise to his current position, particularly in the realm of 5G cell site power installations. As both an Engineer and Project Manager, he leads the engineering and execution of cell site antennas across the DC region, ensuring that communication networks are effectively extended and built to meet the growing demands of modern connectivity.  
  
Parker's proficiency in AutoCAD and SolidWorks allows him to create precise designs and models that facilitate the seamless integration of power systems with telecommunications infrastructure. His experience with EZ Power and Finite Element Analysis enhances his ability to optimize power distribution and ensure reliability in high-demand environments. Collaborating closely with cell providers, Parker is instrumental in meeting execution goals, navigating complex project requirements, and ensuring that all engineering designs align with industry standards.  
  
In addition to his technical skills, Parker excels in project management, coordinating efforts with contractors to track engineering designs and oversee project timelines. His strong communication skills and ability to foster collaboration among diverse teams are key to the successful delivery of projects. With a commitment to enhancing utility services and a passion for advancing technology in the utilities industry, Parker Wright continues to make significant contributions to Pepco Holdings and the broader community.

Italian ideas for building a better world.  
  
SIMEM, established in 1963, design and manufacture machinery and plants for the construction and materials processing industry, as well as environmental protection.  
Throughout the last 5 decades, high quality combined with state of the art solutions, allowed SIMEM to develop the following Business Units:  
  
CONCRETE TECNOLOGIES : provide advanced mixing and batching technology of the highest quality  
PRECAST PLANTS: provide turnkey solutions for automated manufacturing of wet and dry cast concrete products  
UNDERGROUND SOLUTIONS: provide equipment, engineering and solutions for tunneling and mining  
MEGAPROJECTS: provide complete construction planning for hydropower dam projects  
ROADS: provide mobile plants for concrete pavements, cold asphalt mix and recycling, foamed bitumen mix  
SOLID TREATMENT PLANTS: provide reclaim and recycle options for solid waste and contaminated soils  
  
From the beginning, SIMEM equipment has been known for quality, heavy duty design and research and development performance, supported by a proactive service organization with spare parts availablility, trained technicians, and technical support for customers. These comprehensive resources are convincing many customers to rely upon SIMEM plants for their projects, starting from portable ready-mix units up to large projects which are already part of SIMEM history. Several major projects include:  
  
 Follow Line tunnel, Oslo.  
 Mexico City new international airport, Mexico.

About TEAM Tourism Consulting
-----------------------------

TEAM Tourism Consulting is an international consultancy specialising in strategic and operational planning in all aspects of destination management and marketing. TEAM is committed to tourism development that is truly sustainable and also offers services in sustainable tourism development and management.  
  
Our consultants combine extensive experience as practitioners, managing destination operations, with many years of consultancy experience working for DMOs and related organisations around the world.  
  
TEAM has undertaken projects in more than twenty countries, including China, Australia, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Montserrat, Ethiopia, Seychelles, South Africa, Estonia, Slovenia, Ireland, Portugal and Belgium and throughout the UK, at national, regional and local level.  
  
We have been commissioned by UNWTO (http://www.unwto.org/), the World Tourism Organization, to research and produce several reports and publications.  
  
TEAM also worked for the European Travel Commission (ETC), most importantly running the New Media Trend Watch - a web-based source of intelligence about the use of new media in all the major markets of the world.  
  
We welcome the opportunity to maintain a continuing relationship with clients, working with them not only to develop strategies and plans but also to implement projects successfully and provide continuing advice and assistance.  
  
To find out more about TEAM’s work, recent projects and our team of Associates, please visit: www.team-tourism.com.

About Arsen Kostenko

Arsen Kostenko currently serves as the Chief Operations Officer at Volia Fund, a pivotal organization established in response to the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022. With a mission to support Ukraine in its ongoing struggle for sovereignty and resilience, Arsen plays a crucial role in orchestrating operations that address the multifaceted challenges posed by this conflict. His expertise in video processing, machine learning, and natural language processing positions him at the forefront of innovative solutions that leverage technology to enhance communication, data analysis, and strategic decision-making.  
  
Under Arsen's leadership, Volia Fund has embarked on several key projects aimed at developing scalable, high-performance systems that can withstand the demands of a protracted crisis. His proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Golang, and Java, combined with his deep understanding of Linux environments, enables the team to create robust applications that facilitate efficient resource allocation and data management. Arsen's focus on computer vision and object detection technologies has led to the implementation of advanced surveillance and monitoring systems, critical for ensuring safety and security in volatile regions.  
  
Moreover, Arsen's strong background in business analysis and system scalability ensures that Volia Fund's initiatives are not only technically sound but also strategically aligned with the long-term goals of supporting Ukraine. His adeptness with tools like PostgreSQL, JBoss Application Server, and Git further enhances the operational efficiency of the organization. As the challenges facing Ukraine evolve, Arsen Kostenko remains committed to leveraging his skills and expertise to drive impactful change, embodying the spirit of resilience and innovation that defines Volia Fund's mission.

About JBM International Limited
-------------------------------

JBM International Ltd is one of the largest aluminium alloy ingot manufacturers in the United Kingdom. We are an accredited member of the London Metal Exchange and are capable of producing 24,000 tonnes of branded ingot a year.  
  
We maintain a proven track record in supplying a global market to some of the largest consumers in the world.  
  
JBM International Ltd can produce bespoke alloy ingot tailored to our client’s specification. Our success comes from 34 years of experience in the secondary aluminium refining business, by providing revolutionary and innovative concepts to our customers.  
  
We continually work to the highest industry standards in every aspect of our operations to provide a world class product whereby we strive to be responsive and flexible to our client’s needs.  
  
JBMI purchases all aluminium scrap classifications as well as various other non-ferrous scrap grades, including copper and silicon.  
  
We purchase up to 3,000 tonnes of aluminium scrap per month, so we always welcome an enquiry with materials you have to offer.  
  
JBM International Ltd are the UK’s Dross handling specialists and have both milling and tolling facilities on site, both of which can be offered alongside purchasing alloy ingot and sow. Milling can be offered to maximise recovery from aluminium dross by converting the dross into metallics.

Loncin Holdings Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “Loncin” www.loncin.com) is an investment holding Group Company, which takes industry as foundation, insists on the guideline of domestic and international advanced level, and makes capital operations and industrial investments actively.  
With more than 30 years development, Loncin has held controlling shares and taken up shares in many listed companies. It has been involved in the fields of industry, finance, environmental protection, automobile trading, strategic and financial investments, etc. Loncin is the controlling shareholder of Loncin Motor Co., Ltd. (SH603766), Hanhua Financial Holding Co., Ltd. (HK03903), Shanghai Fenghua (Group) Co., Ltd. (SH600615), USUM Investment Group Co., Ltd. and Chongqing Jinling Auto (Group) Co., Ltd.; it is one of the major shareholders of Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (HK03618). Till 2014, Loncin has approximately more than 15,000 employees, total assets of about 55 billion RMB, and accumulated tax payments of more than 7 billion RMB.  
  
For 14 years, Loncin has continuously won the honors of top 500 enterprises in China, and has been awarded as “Chinese excellent private enterprise”, “national trademark strategy demonstration enterprise”, “national excellence-creating advanced primary party organization” and “national enterprise culture demonstration base”.  
  
Loncin, has determined three strategies, namely internationalization strategy, industry-leading strategy and management innovation strategy, with the corporate vision of “to be a leading investment holding group in china”, continues to innovate and endeavors for growth.

.

What is the Pop Physique workout and how does it differ from other fitness classes?

Pop Physique offers a unique barre workout that combines elements of ballet, Pilates, and strength training. Unlike traditional fitness classes, Pop Physique focuses on small, controlled movements that target specific muscle groups, promoting lean muscle development and flexibility. The classes are designed to be both challenging and accessible, making them suitable for all fitness levels.

Do I need any prior experience in ballet or fitness to join a Pop Physique class?

No prior experience is necessary to participate in a Pop Physique class. Our instructors are trained to accommodate all skill levels, from beginners to advanced fitness enthusiasts. The classes are structured to help you build strength and confidence, regardless of your background in ballet or fitness.

What should I wear and bring to a Pop Physique class?

We recommend wearing comfortable, form-fitting workout attire that allows for a full range of motion. Grip socks are encouraged for safety and to enhance your performance on the barre. You should also bring a water bottle to stay hydrated during the class. All other equipment, such as mats and weights, is provided at our studios.

Are Pop Physique studios eco-friendly?

Yes, Pop Physique is committed to sustainability and eco-friendliness. Our studios are designed with modern architecture that incorporates sustainable materials and energy-efficient practices. We strive to create a positive impact on the environment while providing a welcoming and inspiring space for our clients.

Can I attend a class at any Pop Physique location, or do I need to register for a specific studio?

You can attend classes at any Pop Physique location with a valid membership or class pass. We encourage you to explore different studios to experience the unique atmosphere and community at each location. However, it's always a good idea to check the class schedule in advance to ensure your preferred class time is available.

What are the membership options available at Pop Physique?

Pop Physique offers a variety of membership options to suit different needs and lifestyles. These include single class passes, multi-class packs, and monthly unlimited memberships. We also provide special promotions and packages for new members. For the most up-to-date information on pricing and membership options, please visit our website or contact your local studio.

About Duncan Aviation
---------------------

EXPERIENCE. UNLIKE ANY OTHER.  
  
Duncan Aviation is the largest privately owned business jet service provider in the world. With complete Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) service offerings at three beautiful US facilities, strategically placed regional shops, and mobile technical teams able to provide services worldwide, we help business aircraft operators get the most value from their aircraft ownership.  
  
Our premier aircraft services–delivered on time–include airframe & engine maintenance, avionics installations, interior & paint completions/modifications, avionics/instrument/accessory repairs & overhauls and parts support for aircraft manufactured by Bombardier, Dassault, Textron, Gulfstream and Embraer. Our avionics satellites and airframe and engine Rapid Response teams provide airframe, avionics and engine services in the field for scheduled and AOG work. And our parts and components teams give 24/7/365 support worldwide with knowledgeable reps who answer the phone day or night. We also provide complete aircraft acquisition and sales services for those looking to buy or sell a pre-owned aircraft.  
  
Even with these vast resources at the ready, we serve customers with the friendliness and responsiveness of a small-town company. That is because our people have a passion for aviation and customer service. They are among the most experienced in the industry and their quality of service is among the best in the world.  
  
Owned and operated by the Duncan family since our founding in 1956, Duncan Aviation is well-known and respected by operators, manufacturers and other service providers worldwide for our quality, value, timeliness, communication, work ethic and expertise.
