Visit our website for a virtual tour of our facility: www.reedlane.com  
  
Reed-Lane is a mid-sized, privately owned, contract packager located in northern New Jersey that has been serving the pharmaceutical market for over 60 years. Now located in a 132,000 square foot facility in Wayne, New Jersey, Reed-Lane has created innovative packaging solutions for leading Rx, OTC, and generic drug companies. Our services include solid dose bottling and blistering, high speed pouching of solids, and secondary packaging like wallet carding, cartonning, and kitting of vials and syringes. We are FDA approved and DEA licensed. We can provide serialization services from the item level through full pallet aggregation for bottles and cartons. Our new controlled cold storage unit can keep products at 2°C-8°C.  
  
As a privately held company, Reed-Lane has cultivated the ability to be far more flexible and cost effective than many of its publicly traded competitors. This flexibility has made it possible for the company to serve the complex and increasing packaging needs of its pharmaceutical customers with great speed and agility. Quality assurance remains the hallmark of Reed-Lane, as every product packaged is subjected to rigorous testing to ensure that we exceed the standards of cGMP and FDA compliance.

What types of lighting solutions does Republic offer?

Our offerings include energy-efficient LED lighting, architectural lighting, outdoor lighting, and specialized lighting controls. How does Republic approach energy management for businesses?

At Republic, we take a comprehensive approach to energy management by conducting thorough energy audits and assessments. We identify areas for improvement and implement solutions such as advanced HVAC systems, energy-efficient lighting, and smart controls. Our goal is to help businesses reduce their energy costs and environmental impact while improving overall efficiency.

What industries does Republic serve?

Republic serves a diverse range of industries, including commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, and hospitality. Our expertise allows us to tailor our services and solutions to meet the specific needs of each sector, ensuring optimal performance and satisfaction for our clients.

Can Republic assist with HVAC system installations and maintenance?

Yes, Republic specializes in the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems. Our team of experienced technicians is trained to handle various heating and cooling systems, ensuring they operate efficiently and effectively. We also offer preventative maintenance plans to help extend the lifespan of your equipment.

What are hydronics, and how does Republic utilize them?

Hydronics refers to the use of water as a heat transfer medium in heating and cooling systems. Republic utilizes hydronic systems to provide efficient temperature control for buildings. Our hydronic solutions include radiant floor heating, chilled beams, and boiler systems, which are designed to deliver comfort while minimizing energy usage.

Does Republic provide support for refrigeration systems?

Absolutely! Republic offers comprehensive refrigeration services, including installation, maintenance, and repair of commercial refrigeration systems. Our team is skilled in handling various types of refrigeration equipment, ensuring optimal performance and compliance with industry standards. We also provide energy-efficient solutions to help reduce operational costs.

What services does Hitachi Zosen Inova offer in the energy from waste sector?

Hitachi Zosen Inova (HZI) specializes in providing comprehensive solutions in the energy from waste (EfW) sector. Our services include engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of EfW plants, as well as the design and implementation of waste combustion systems, anaerobic digestion facilities, and gas upgrading technologies. We focus on converting municipal and industrial waste into renewable energy, thereby contributing to sustainable waste management and energy production.

How does anaerobic digestion work and what are its benefits?

Anaerobic digestion is a biological process that breaks down organic matter in the absence of oxygen, producing biogas and digestate. The biogas can be used for electricity generation, heating, or upgraded to renewable natural gas. The digestate can be used as a nutrient-rich fertilizer. The benefits of anaerobic digestion include reducing landfill waste, lowering greenhouse gas emissions, producing renewable energy, and creating valuable by-products that can enhance soil health.

What industries does Hitachi Zosen Inova serve?

Hitachi Zosen Inova serves a diverse range of industries, including municipal waste management, industrial waste processing, agriculture, and energy production. Our solutions are tailored to meet the specific needs of each sector, ensuring efficient waste treatment and energy recovery. We work closely with local authorities, private waste management companies, and industrial clients to implement sustainable waste-to-energy solutions.

What is the process of gas upgrading and why is it important?

Gas upgrading is the process of purifying biogas to produce renewable natural gas (RNG) that meets pipeline quality standards. This process typically involves removing impurities such as carbon dioxide, hydrogen sulfide, and moisture. Gas upgrading is important because it allows for the utilization of biogas as a clean energy source that can be injected into natural gas grids or used as vehicle fuel, contributing to the reduction of fossil fuel dependency and greenhouse gas emissions.

Can Hitachi Zosen Inova help with retrofitting existing waste management facilities?

Yes, Hitachi Zosen Inova offers retrofitting services for existing waste management facilities to enhance their efficiency and sustainability. Our team can assess the current operations and recommend upgrades or modifications to incorporate advanced technologies such as improved combustion systems, gas upgrading solutions, and energy recovery enhancements. This helps facilities to optimize their performance and meet evolving regulatory requirements.

What are the environmental benefits of energy from waste technologies?

Energy from waste technologies provide significant environmental benefits, including the reduction of landfill waste, lower greenhouse gas emissions, and the recovery of valuable energy resources. By converting waste into energy, HZI helps to minimize the environmental impact of waste disposal while promoting a circular economy. Additionally, our technologies contribute to the reduction of reliance on fossil fuels and support the transition to renewable energy sources.

What types of services does Pensar Development offer?

Pensar Development is a full-service product development company that provides a wide range of services including Industrial Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Software Engineering. Our expertise allows us to support clients throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from initial concept through to manufacturing and support.

How does Pensar ensure that its products connect with users?

At Pensar, we prioritize user experience in our design process. Our team employs Experience Design principles to create intuitive and engaging products. We conduct thorough research and discovery phases, including user testing and feedback sessions, to ensure that our solutions meet the needs and expectations of end-users.

What industries does Pensar Development serve?

Pensar Development serves a diverse range of industries, including consumer electronics, medical devices, industrial equipment, and IoT (Internet of Things) applications. Our multidisciplinary team is equipped to tackle the unique challenges and requirements of each sector, ensuring that we deliver tailored solutions that drive success.

Can Pensar assist with manufacturing ramp-up and support?

Yes, Pensar offers Manufacturing Ramp-up & Support services to help clients transition from product development to full-scale production. Our team collaborates closely with manufacturers to ensure that the product is produced efficiently and meets quality standards. We also provide ongoing support to address any issues that may arise during the manufacturing process.

What is the role of firmware engineering in Pensar's product development?

Firmware Engineering is a critical component of our product development process, especially for electronic devices. At Pensar, our firmware engineers design and develop the low-level software that controls hardware components, ensuring that the product operates as intended. This includes optimizing performance, enhancing security, and enabling seamless integration with other software systems.

How does Pensar approach research and discovery in product development?

Pensar takes a comprehensive approach to research and discovery, which is essential for understanding market needs and user expectations. We conduct market analysis, user interviews, and competitive assessments to gather insights that inform our design and engineering processes. About Fusion Contact Centers, LLC
---------------------------------

Building customer relationships isn’t so easy any more. Today’s digital-age buyers would rather text than talk. They shop by click-and-order, not brick and mortar. “Customer loyalty” is almost an oxymoron: if you can’t help them right away, they will hit the web and find someone else who will. This detached form of buying and selling makes it more important to build meaningful relationships that create loyal customers.  
  
Flourishing sales need deep-rooted relationships. People quickly see through the scripted lines and phony robo-chats that most companies pass off as “customer care.” Every contact is a rare opportunity to set your company apart in the hearts and minds of your audience. It’s your chance to create a human connection -- whether it’s a product order, a service inquiry or a complex tech support issue.  
  
Let Fusion help you re-connect with your customers. At our regional centers in California and Nevada, we coach our people in grammar and social networking -- not just sales and service -- skills that cut through the detachment of digital commerce. The result: we do more than placate your customers. We create meaningful conversations that lead to repeat purchases and raving fans.

About Control Data Corporation
------------------------------

Control Data Corporation (CDC) was a mainframe and supercomputer firm. CDC was one of the nine major United States computer companies through most of the 1960s; the others were IBM, Burroughs Corporation, DEC, NCR, General Electric, Honeywell, RCA, and UNIVAC. CDC was well-known and highly regarded throughout the industry at the time. For most of the 1960s, Seymour Cray worked at CDC and developed a series of machines that were the fastest computers in the world by far, until Cray left the company to found Cray Research (CRI) in the 1970s. After several years of losses in the early 1980s, in 1988 CDC started to leave the computer manufacturing business and sell the related parts of the company, a process that was completed in 1992 with the creation of Control Data Systems, Inc. The remaining businesses of CDC currently operate as Ceridian. (Source: Wikipedia.)

About Lima Municipal Court
--------------------------

The Lima Municipal Court handles traffic, criminal, and civil matters originating in Allen County, Ohio.  
  
Civil  
The Civil Division handles cases in which the amount of money in dispute does not exceed $15,000. Complaints involving landlord tenant disputes, rent escrows and appeals to the Bureau of Motor Vehicles are filed with this division. The civil division also handles small claims cases, in which the amount of money in dispute is $6,000 or less.  
  
Criminal & Traffic  
The Criminal and Traffic Division processes and maintains the entries and orders of the Court, accepts bail and bond on all offenses and establishes and monitors defendants' payment plans. Felony charges from arrest to preliminary hearing are recorded and transmitted to Common Pleas Court.  
  
Probation  
The Lima Municipal Court Probation Department is responsible for post- and pre-sentence investigations, probation supervision, and community service intake and referral. The Probation Department is also responsible to work with the City Prosecutor for preparation for all non-compliance cases in Probation and Community service.

What types of custom cabinetry does Vigilant Inc. offer?

Vigilant Inc. specializes in a wide range of custom cabinetry solutions tailored to meet individual client needs. We work closely with clients to create bespoke designs that reflect their personal style while ensuring durability and quality craftsmanship.

How does Vigilant Inc. ensure the quality of its products?

At Vigilant Inc., we pride ourselves on our commitment to quality. With over 25 years of experience, we utilize skilled craftsmanship and high-quality materials in every project. Can Vigilant Inc. help with the design of a wine cellar?

What industries does Vigilant Inc. serve?

About Westnetz GmbH
-------------------

Die Westnetz GmbH mit Sitz in Dortmund ist der Verteilnetzbetreiber für Strom und Gas im Westen Deutschlands. Das Unternehmen ist eine 100-prozentige Tochter der Westenergie AG. Westnetz betreibt mit 5.100 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern eine Vielzahl von Netzen unterschiedlicher Eigentümer im Westen Deutschlands. Sie ist ein unabhängiger Verteilnetzbetreiber und stellt die Gas- und Stromnetze allen Marktteilnehmern diskriminierungsfrei zur Verfügung. Innerhalb der Westenergie AG verantwortet Westnetz im regulierten Bereich Planung, Bau, Instandhaltung und Betrieb von 180.000 Kilometern Stromnetz und 24.000 Kilometern Gasnetz. Westnetz unterstützt die Energiewende in Deutschland mit zukunftsorientiertem Aus- und Umbau der Netze sowie zahlreichen Innovationsprojekten.Dafür brauchen wir Pioniere, die mit Mut und Kreativität eine nachhaltige Zukunft gestalten möchten. About The Prisma - The Multicultural Newspaper
----------------------------------------------

The Prisma Is an independent and multicultural newspaper run by a voluntary group of professional journalists, media experts as well as young and enthusiastic graduate people.  
  
It is a bilingual publication, it publishes in both Spanish and English, to bring together the speakers of these two languages in the United Kingdom. It works to create links between immigrants, Spanish speaking or otherwise, and natives of the UK.  
  
As a truly independent publication The Prisma works to make a contribution to contemporary journalism, via the internet. It emerged in the middle of the crisis in order to confront it, aware of the obstacles it faced, but persisting with its unique face nevertheless.  
  
Works for the elimination of racial and cultural prejudices, and is committed to social justice and equality of opportunity. Our philosophy and our content promote and defend these values of the multicultural society of the UK, especially in the case of Latin Americans.

About Reynolds Restoration Services, Inc.
-----------------------------------------

Reynolds Restoration Services, Inc. is a leading disaster restoration and reconstruction company headquartered in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. Serving the regions of Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Washington D.C., and Maryland, Reynolds Restoration is dedicated to providing exceptional service in the face of adversity. With a team of qualified and experienced professionals, the company specializes in responding to emergencies caused by fire, smoke, water, mold, and wind damage.  
  
The comprehensive range of services offered by Reynolds Restoration includes water extraction, fire damage restoration, mold remediation, and storm damage repair. Utilizing advanced technologies and industry best practices, the team is equipped to handle projects of any size, ensuring that properties are restored to their pre-loss condition efficiently and effectively. Their commitment to customer satisfaction is evident in their 24/7 emergency response, allowing them to address urgent situations promptly and mitigate further damage.  
  
Reynolds Restoration Services prides itself on its extensive experience across various industries, including residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Their expertise enables them to tailor solutions to meet the unique needs of each client, whether it’s a small home or a large commercial facility. By combining state-of-the-art equipment with a compassionate approach, Reynolds Restoration not only restores properties but also provides peace of mind to those affected by disasters. With a reputation built on reliability and excellence, Reynolds Restoration Services, Inc. stands as a trusted partner in the restoration industry.

In summary, Vienna Teng is a multifaceted artist whose music continues to resonate with listeners through its emotional depth and compelling storytelling. About WEG
---------

Founded in 1961, WEG is a global electric-electronic equipment company, operating mainly in the capital goods sector with solutions in electric machines, automation and paints for several sectors, including infrastructure, steel, pulp and paper, oil and gas, mining, among many others.  
  
WEG stands out in innovation by constantly developing solutions to meet the major trends in energy efficiency, renewable energy and electric mobility. With manufacturing units in 15 countries and present in more than 135 countries, the company has more than 40,000 employees worldwide.  
  
WEG’s net revenue reached R$ 29.9 billion in 2022, 59.3% from outside Brazil.  
  
Our business areas are divided as follows.  
  
Industrial Electro-Electronic Equipment  
This area includes electric motors, drives and industrial automation equipment and services, and maintenance services. Electric motors and other related equipment find applications in practically all industrial segments, in equipment such as compressors, pumps and fans, for example.  
  
Energy Generation, Transmission and Distribution (GTD)  
Products and services included in this area are electric generators for hydraulic and thermal power plants (biomass), hydro turbines (small hydroelectric plants or PCH, and hydroelectric generators or CGH)), wind turbines, transformers, substations, control panels and system integration services.  
  
Motors for Domestic Use  
In this business area, our focus is the market of single phase motors for durable consumer goods, such as washing machines, air conditioners, water pumps, among others.  
  
Paints and Varnishes  
In this area, which includes liquid paints, powder paints, and electro-insulating varnishes, we have a very clear focus on industrial applications in Brazil and are expanding to Latin America and other regions.

However, his contributions to music and the arts extend far beyond these iconic roles, as Little Steven has made significant contributions to the rock and roll genre, acting, and political activism.  
  
Little Steven's musical journey began in the 1960s when he formed the band "The Shadows," which eventually evolved into "Southside Johnny and the Asbury Jukes." His soulful guitar playing and signature bandana became synonymous with the E Street Band's dynamic live performances, and he played a pivotal role in the success of hit albums such as "Born to Run" and "Darkness on the Edge of Town."

Little Steven's activism has continued to this day, as he has used his influence to promote positive change in the world.

Through his radio platform, Little Steven has introduced listeners to a diverse array of music, showcasing his passion for the art form and his dedication to preserving its legacy.

About Jean Reno

Jean Reno is a versatile and dynamic French actor whose magnetism and talent have solidified him as one of the most recognizable and acclaimed figures in the film industry. Born Juan Moreno y Herrera-Jiménez on July 30, 1948, in Casablanca, Morocco, Reno later moved to France and fully embraced his passion for acting. With his rugged charm, intense gaze, and remarkable range, he has captivated audiences worldwide and left an indelible mark on both French and international cinema.  
  
Reno's career spans over four decades, during which he has graced the screen with his commanding presence in a multitude of roles across various genres. His breakthrough came in the late 1980s with Luc Besson's action-packed thriller, "The Big Blue" (1988), where he portrayed the enigmatic and philosophical deep-sea diver, Enzo Molinari. This role marked the beginning of a successful collaboration between Reno and Besson, resulting in some of the most iconic and critically acclaimed films of their careers.  
  
One of their most notable collaborations came in 1994 with the release of "Léon: The Professional," a neo-noir crime thriller in which Reno delivers a career-defining performance as the titular character, Léon. In this mesmerizing role, he portrays a hitman with an unexpected capacity for compassion and fatherly love when he takes in a young girl, played by a young Natalie Portman, after her family is brutally murdered. Reno's portrayal of Léon is a masterclass in subtlety and emotional depth, elevating the film to a whole new level.  
  
While Reno is predominantly known for his work in action and crime films, his talent and versatility have proven to transcend genres. He effortlessly transitions between intense dramas, romantic comedies, and historical epics, leaving a lasting impression with each portrayal. In "The Crimson Rivers" (2000), he showcases his ability to captivate audiences in a gripping crime thriller, playing a detective investigating a series of gruesome murders in a remote mountain town. Reno's brooding presence and unwavering determination give the film an electrifying intensity that heightens the suspense.

Rocket specializes in a wide range of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, and engineering. Rocket stands out from traditional recruiting agencies by integrating cutting-edge technology and data science into our recruiting processes. While many agencies rely on manual methods, we utilize automation and machine learning to enhance efficiency and accuracy. This enables us to provide a faster, more effective recruiting experience, ultimately leading to better matches and higher satisfaction for both clients and candidates.

At Rocket, we prioritize the candidate experience by maintaining clear communication, providing timely feedback, and offering personalized support throughout the recruitment process. About Bosco's Pizza Co.
-----------------------

Back in 1988, when Bosco’s Carry-Out Pizzeria first opened its doors, no one had any idea that the little corner pizzeria would become a national phenomenon! Today as Bosco's Pizza Co., we produce and distribute millions of Bosco Sticks and Bosco Pizza throughout the United States every week.  
  
A generation of school kids have grown up with Bosco Sticks. They have become a favorite not just in schools, but also in restaurants, cafeterias, c-stores and concessions all over the country. Bosco Sticks are now available for retail purchase too, so you can enjoy them at home!  
  
What makes our products so good? Do we have a secret ingredient? We do - its time and attention. Other frozen pizzas and bread sticks have never been able to match our quality because we take the time to treat our dough. We make all of our dough from scratch the way bakeries do, so Bosco Sticks and Bosco Pizza crusts taste like real bread. Other companies try to imitate us, but take short cuts to save time and money. The short cuts may make for a faster process can never match the quality of our products.  
  
We’re proud of our work. We’re proud of our products. We’re proud to be Bosco Team members.

About Harrell Nut Company
-------------------------

Harrell Nut Company, a pecan producer and distributor since 1973, has become an industry leader through quality and service. With facilities in Georgia and Texas, the company has established itself in both of the country's top pecan-growing regions. There, Harrell Nut Company processes, stores, ships, and sells the highest-quality products. The company offers options for wholesale buyers, retail shoppers, and fundraising organizations. In each market, Harrell Nut Company ensures that each buyer receives the best products in a timely manner. Harrell Nut Company offers its wholesale products under the main company name. These products serve the needs of bakers, supermarkets, and other commercial buyers. Harrell Nut's commitment to quality has helped the organization maintain its reputation as an industry leader. To ensure quality, the organization follows some of food service's most rigorous standards. In addition to its own quality-control procedures, its facilities follow guidelines set by the Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (H.A.C.C.P.) Based Food Safety Program, Good Manufacturing Practices (G.M.P.s), and other industry quality-control methods. As a result, the organization's facilities have earned Safe Quality Food (S.Q.F.) 2000's Level 2 Certification, a nationally recognized quality and safety designation. In addition, the company's facilities are Kosher certified to better meet the needs of its customers.

About NIH Clinical Center (CC)
------------------------------

The National Institutes of Health Clinical Center (NIH CC), located at 10 Center Drive in Bethesda, Maryland, stands as America’s premier research hospital, dedicated to advancing clinical research and translating laboratory discoveries into innovative treatments. Established to bridge the gap between scientific inquiry and patient care, the Clinical Center plays a pivotal role in the biomedical research landscape, serving a diverse array of industries including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and healthcare.  
  
Since its inception, the NIH CC has been at the forefront of clinical trials, offering a unique environment where clinician-investigators collaborate to develop and evaluate new therapies and interventions. The center's state-of-the-art facilities, including the Mark O. Hatfield Clinical Research Center, enable cutting-edge research across various medical disciplines, from oncology to infectious diseases. The Clinical Center's commitment to excellence was recognized in 2011 when it received the prestigious Lasker-Bloomberg Public Service Award, underscoring its role as a model for research hospitals worldwide.  
  
Utilizing advanced technologies and methodologies, the NIH CC conducts a wide range of clinical studies, employing innovative diagnostic tools and treatment protocols that enhance patient outcomes. By fostering a culture of collaboration and discovery, the Clinical Center not only contributes to the scientific community but also significantly impacts public health, ensuring that the latest research translates into tangible benefits for patients across the nation. For more information, visit their website at http://clinicalcenter.nih.gov/.

About Barton Community College
------------------------------

Barton Community College, headquartered at 245 NE 30 RD in Great Bend, Kansas, is a dynamic institution dedicated to providing quality education and training to a diverse student population. Nestled on a picturesque 160-acre campus, just three miles northeast of Great Bend, the college features eight main buildings, multiple phases of student housing, and specialized facilities such as the Midwest Utility Pipeline Training Center. Serving surrounding counties including Russell, Ellsworth, Rush, Rice, and Pawnee, Barton is committed to meeting the educational needs of its community.  
  
The college has established strong partnerships with the Kansas Department of Corrections, providing educational opportunities within local correctional facilities, including the Ellsworth Correctional Facility and Larned Correctional Mental Health Facility. Additionally, Barton has a long-standing relationship with Fort Riley, known as home to "The Big Red One." Since 1984, this partnership has expanded to support soldiers, their families, and the Junction City community through various training programs.  
  
Barton Community College also boasts a Grandview Plaza branch, which is home to its Hazardous Materials and Emergency Management programs, as well as the innovative BARTonline global online education platform. Recently, the college has developed a partnership to serve military service members at Fort Leavenworth, further enhancing its commitment to accessible education. For those interested in pursuing a career in education, the college offers a comprehensive list of qualified Barton Community College teachers, ensuring students receive top-notch instruction across various disciplines. With a focus on community engagement and workforce development, Barton Community College continues to be a vital educational resource in central Kansas.

About The Carnrite Group
------------------------

The Carnrite Group (“Carnrite”) is a management consultancy focused primarily in the energy, industrial and private equity sectors. From offices in Houston, Texas, London, United Kingdom and the UAE, Carnrite deploys its unique combination of consulting and industry expertise to projects globally. Carnrite is a dedicated, practical business partner with the ability to implement complex change. Areas of expertise include strategy and transaction support, business transformation, human capital, the Energy Transition and Digital Transformation. Carnrite recognizes that its clients face difficult business decisions – its mission is to make it easier for them.  
  
In November 2022, The Carnrite Group announced it is integrating into Alvarez & Marsal, a global firm we have admired for decades. Our team joins A&M's energy practice, which supports clients in oil and gas, renewable energies, utilities and power generation, mining, and chemicals. The combination provides us with a global platform, expanded service offerings, and deep capabilities. The Carnrite Group's international businesses will continue to operate under The Carnrite Group brand during an initial integration period, while working in close collaboration with A&M.

About Piggly Wiggly Midwest, LLC
--------------------------------

Welcome C&S Family of Companies  
  
Piggly Wiggly Midwest continues to grow the Piggly Wiggly banner. Currently, the Company operates corporate stores and services independent franchisees under a chain-style program.  
  
In 1949, the Company entered into a franchise agreement enabling it to use the “Piggly Wiggly” name for the first time in southern and eastern Wisconsin. The nucleus of the present 104 store retail group traces its origin to the early Piggly Wiggly franchisers located in Sturgeon Bay, Manitowoc, Green Bay, and Kaukauna.  
  
With the continued growth, the Company recognized the need to have a strong nationally accepted private label program. Today, the Piggly Wiggly stores are still part of the Topco co-op, offering the finest store brands products under the Food Club, Valu Time and Top Care labels.  
  
The Company purchased a facility in 1957 on what would become the site of the current twenty-acre distribution center in Sheboygan, Wisconsin. Today the Company’s three distribution centers supplies grocery, produce, meat, bakery, deli, frozen, dairy, health and beauty care and general merchandise to the Piggly Wiggly stores.  
  
In September of 2007, Paul Butera joined by members of his family purchased the Company from Certifresh. Paul Butera, a Chicagoland grocer since opening his first store in 1962, brought his experience and knowledge as the owner/operator of “Butera Market,” one of Chicagoland’s oldest and largest independent grocery chains, to Sheboygan, WI. With the help of the Piggly Wiggly team of officers, supervisors, management and store personnel, he applied his skills in buying, advertising, marketing, store designing, and layout planning to all facets of the business and embarked upon an aggressive advertising and expansion campaign.

About The SAFE Alliance
-----------------------

The SAFE Alliance is a Central Texas nonprofit organization working to stop abuse for everyone. SAFE supports children, adults, and families who have experienced abuse by providing safety, stability, and healing. To more effectively put an end to child abuse, sexual assault, domestic violence, and sex trafficking, SAFE provides shelter, counseling, legal assistance, sexual assault forensic exams, a charter school, and more.  
  
In addition to direct services, SAFE works to prevent violence before it occurs through parenting assistance and education, programs that promote healthy teen relationships, and working with communities disproportionately affected by abuse. Violence and abuse are a cycle, often transferred across generations. We work to break that cycle.  
  
As part of the SAFE Alliance, the SAFE INSTITUTE provides workplace training and consulting for companies to prevent sexual harassment and create safe, respectful work environments.  
  
SAFE is a merger of SafePlace and the Austin's Children's Shelter and has over 45 years of experience in the field of violence prevention and response. Learn more about our merger at safeaustin.org/merger  
  
With an annual budget of more than $20 million, more than 350 employees and thousands of volunteers, SAFE now has prevention and crisis programs operating across multiple campuses and in the schools, hospitals, courts, county and District Attorney’s offices.  
  
NEED HELP?  
SAFEline is a 24-hour confidential hotline for people seeking help with sexual or domestic violence, child abuse, human trafficking, or parenting support and is available by phone at 512.267.SAFE (7233), by text at 737.888.7233, or by online chat at safeaustin.org/chat.

About Eddie Ojeda

Eddie Ojeda is an American musician best known for his work as the lead guitarist for the heavy metal band Twisted Sister. Born on August 5, 1955, in the Bronx, New York, Ojeda’s passion for music began at a young age, and he quickly gravitated toward the guitar. Influenced by the likes of Jimi Hendrix, Eric Clapton, and Led Zeppelin, Ojeda honed his skills and developed his own unique style that would later help define Twisted Sister’s sound.  
  
In 1972, Ojeda co-founded Twisted Sister alongside vocalist Dee Snider, bassist Mark Mendoza, and drummer A.J. Pero. The band quickly gained notoriety in the New York City club scene for their energetic live performances and catchy, anthemic songs. Ojeda’s flamboyant stage presence, flashy guitar playing, and signature red guitar earned him a prominent role within the band and helped solidify Twisted Sister as one of the leading acts in the glam metal movement of the 1980s.  
  
With Ojeda’s musical prowess and songwriting contributions, Twisted Sister released a string of successful albums, including their breakthrough 1984 release “Stay Hungry.” The album featured the band’s most recognizable hit, “We're Not Gonna Take It,” which showcased Ojeda’s driving guitar riffs and memorable solos. The song’s rebellious anthem and accompanying music video propelled Twisted Sister to international stardom and solidified their status as icons of the heavy metal genre.  
  
In addition to his work with Twisted Sister, Ojeda has also pursued a successful solo career, releasing several albums that showcase his versatility as a guitarist and songwriter. His solo work explores a wide range of musical styles, from hard rock and heavy metal to blues and acoustic ballads, demonstrating Ojeda’s ability to adapt and evolve as an artist. His solo debut, “Axes 2 Axes,” was released in 2005 to critical acclaim, featuring guest appearances by fellow musicians such as Ronnie James Dio and Dee Snider.  
  
Throughout his career, Ojeda has remained a dedicated performer and collaborator, working with various artists on side projects and contributing to albums and live performances outside of Twisted Sister. His passion for music and dedication to his craft have earned him a loyal fan base and the respect of his peers in the music industry. In recognition of his contributions to the world of heavy metal, Ojeda was inducted into the Long Island Music Hall of Fame in 2006, alongside his bandmates in Twisted Sister.  
  
In addition to his musical endeavors, Ojeda is also an entrepreneur, running his own recording studio and producing music for other artists. His experience and expertise in the industry have made him a sought-after producer and collaborator, lending his talents to a variety of projects and helping to shape the sound of numerous albums across different genres.  
  
Eddie Ojeda’s impact on the world of heavy metal and rock music is undeniable, and his influence continues to be felt by musicians and fans alike. With his electrifying performances, memorable guitar riffs, and enduring contributions to the genre, Ojeda has solidified his place as a legendary figure in the world of music. As he continues to create and innovate, Ojeda’s legacy remains as vibrant and powerful as ever, inspiring future generations of musicians to pick up their guitars and rock out with passion and dedication.

About Duke Raleigh Hospital
---------------------------

At Duke Raleigh Hospital, we're proud to be a part of Duke Health. And, we're just as proud to be a part of your community.  
  
From the day we opened our doors as Mary Elizabeth Hospital in 1914 through today, we've always stayed close to our founding philosophy of providing compassionate care to our patients.  
  
Since 1998, Duke Raleigh Hospital has been an important part of Duke Health. Our affiliation with one of the country's best health systems provides our patients with access to the most advanced technology and leading-edge medicine available.  
  
Our hospital's values are the guiding principles we use to fulfill our mission: to provide extraordinary care.  
  
Conveniently located off the beltline in North Raleigh, Duke Raleigh Hospital has 186 beds and an impressive array of programs and services, including the Duke Raleigh Cancer Center, Duke Raleigh Orthopaedic and Spine Center, cardiovascular services, neurosciences including the Duke Raleigh Skull Base and Cerebrovascular Center, advanced digestive care, disease management and prevention, wound healing, outpatient imaging, intensive and progressive care, pain clinic, same-day surgery, emergency department and community outreach and education programs. . For years we've been the hospital of choice for patients with a variety of health care needs.  
  
We are dedicated to building the region’s most experienced and compassionate health care team. A team of individuals who share a commitment to caring for our patients, their families, and our community. Individuals who believe that patients are our number one priority.

What types of chemicals does Colonial Chemical Solutions distribute?

Colonial Chemical Solutions distributes a wide range of chemicals, including industrial and specialty chemicals tailored for various industries. Our offerings include food-grade and kosher-certified chemicals, as well as custom-blended solutions to meet specific customer requirements. We ensure that all products meet stringent quality standards and are compliant with relevant regulations.

How does Colonial Chemical Solutions ensure timely delivery of products?

We pride ourselves on our efficient logistics and supply chain flexibility. With strategically located warehouses in Savannah, GA, Charlotte, NC, Richmond, VA, and Atlanta, GA, we are able to provide timely delivery services across the Southeast. Our dedicated truck fleet and partnerships with reliable carriers allow us to meet our customers' needs promptly and effectively.

What certifications does Colonial Chemical Solutions hold?

Colonial Chemical Solutions is committed to maintaining high standards of quality and safety. We are AIB certified, which ensures our facilities meet rigorous food safety standards. Additionally, we are NSF certified, allowing us to distribute chemicals that comply with public health and safety regulations. Our facilities also adhere to the guidelines set forth by the National Association of Chemical Distributors (NACD).

Can Colonial Chemical Solutions provide custom blending and packaging services?

Yes, we offer custom blending and packaging services to meet the unique needs of our clients. Our experienced team works closely with customers to develop tailored solutions that fit their specific requirements. We utilize precise packaging techniques to ensure product integrity and compliance with industry standards.

What industries does Colonial Chemical Solutions serve?

Colonial Chemical Solutions serves a diverse range of industries, including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, personal care, and industrial manufacturing. Our extensive product portfolio and expertise enable us to cater to the specific needs of each sector, providing high-quality chemicals and exceptional customer service.

What quality control measures does Colonial Chemical Solutions implement?

Quality control is a top priority at Colonial Chemical Solutions. We have an on-site assurance laboratory that conducts rigorous testing to ensure all products meet our high-quality standards. Our quality control processes include thorough inspections, testing of raw materials, and regular audits of our facilities and suppliers to maintain compliance with industry regulations.

About Roundabout Theatre Company
--------------------------------

Founded in 1965, New York’s not-for-profit Roundabout Theatre Company produces a mix of revivals and world premieres in its five theatres on and off Broadway, winning nine Best Revival Tony Awards and debuting such new playwrights as Stephen Karam, Lindsey Ferrentino, Steven Levenson, Joshua Harmon, Ming Peiffer, and Mansa Ra. Its educational initiatives impact 15,000 students and over 1,000 teachers annually.  
  
MISSION  
Roundabout celebrates the power of theatre by spotlighting classics from the past, cultivating new works of the present and educating minds for the future.  
  
OUR WORK  
WE PRODUCE familiar and lesser-known plays and musicals with the ability to take artistic risk as only a not-for-profit can.  
  
WE DISCOVER talented playwrights and provide them long-term artistic support to contribute to the future of the theatrical canon.  
  
WE REDUCE the barriers– financial, physical and cultural– that can inhibit theatergoing.  
  
WE COLLABORATE with a diverse team of artists to identify programming for consideration.  
  
WE BUILD transformational education experiences that enhance teacher practice, deepen student learning, and ignite the future of young people through career training and placement.  
  
WE CAPTURE AND ARCHIVE over five decades of production history as an open resource for artists, scholars, and our community.

About Aeroxchange
-----------------

A strong supply chain is one of the cornerstones of the aviation industry. When operators and the suppliers who support them can both improve efficiency and reduce wasteful, redundant tasks, they collectively become stronger, more reliable, and more profitable.  
  
Aeroxchange’s suite of MRO collaboration platforms allow companies to automate manual, redundant tasks by facilitating the electronic communication of information between 100% of trading partners. Regardless of the technical sophistication of the company, Aeroxchange can facilitate collaboration on MRO Task Cards, Purchase Orders, Repair Orders, Pooling Programs, Consignment/VMI programs, and AOG events all with automated invoicing. Aeroxchange’s platforms support Continuous Improvement processes and by keeping data updated, invoices can be processed automatically with less exceptions and faster payment.  
  
Aeroxchange was founded in July 2000 by a consortium of 13 major global airlines. The founding airlines envisioned a neutral exchange platform to support internet-based electronic supply chain communications between airlines, their partners and suppliers.  
  
Aeroxchange was created to function as a market hub, acting as a single point of connection for all participants. In this capacity, Aeroxchange vastly simplifies participation for everyone. Aeroxchange "translates" the electronic business documents from one trading partner into a format acceptable to the receiving party. Aeroxchange also maintains a common system of record with transaction time stamping for market operations. Security and encryption established once with Aeroxchange enables secure communications between all parties.

About Planview Utility Services Limited
---------------------------------------

Planview Utility Services Limited, headquartered in Markham, Ontario, is a leading provider of integrated solutions for the telecommunications and electric utility sectors. By combining Engineering, Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE), and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) services, Planview delivers a comprehensive suite of offerings designed to enhance operational efficiency and safety for its clients.  
  
The Engineering division specializes in a wide range of services, including pole line designs, attachment permitting, structural analysis, and municipal permits. With a diverse team of engineers, Planview tailors its designs to meet the specific standards of each utility, ensuring compliance and functionality.  
  
In the realm of Subsurface Utility Engineering, Planview stands out for its meticulous approach to utility locates, daylighting through hydro-vac techniques, and detailed surveying. The company prioritizes data collection, transforming exposed assets into actionable GIS reports that facilitate ongoing data improvement. This commitment not only minimizes risks and reduces the need for truck rolls but also emphasizes damage prevention and the safety of employees and the public.  
  
Planview’s GIS Services are integral to supporting asset management and damage prevention for infrastructure owners. By collaborating closely with the Engineering and SUE teams, Planview ensures that clients can maximize their GIS investments through effective data maintenance processes. Utilizing advanced technologies, Planview Utility Services Limited is dedicated to providing innovative solutions that empower utilities and telecoms to operate more efficiently and safely in an ever-evolving landscape.

About John Deacon

John Deacon is a legendary musician known for his impeccable skills as a bass guitarist and songwriter. Born on August 19, 1951, in Leicester, England, Deacon became one of the founding members of the iconic rock band Queen. His unique playing style and contribution to the band's sound were essential in cementing their place in music history.  
  
Deacon's musical journey began at a young age, as he started playing the piano and guitar in his teenage years. However, it was the bass guitar that caught his attention and allowed him to showcase his immense talent. His ability to create unforgettable basslines that effortlessly intertwine with the melodies made him stand out, earning him recognition as one of the greatest bassists of all time.  
  
In 1971, Deacon joined forces with Freddie Mercury, Brian May, and Roger Taylor, forming the iconic band Queen. It didn't take long for the world to notice the unique chemistry and immense talent displayed by these four musicians. Deacon's contributions to the band's sound were significant, as he added a richness and depth to their music that perfectly complemented Mercury's powerful vocals and May's fiery guitar solos.  
  
Deacon's songwriting skills truly shone through in some of Queen's biggest hits. One of his most successful compositions, "Another One Bites the Dust," stands as one of the band's most recognizable and commercially successful songs. Released in 1980, the funky bassline and infectious rhythm captivated audiences worldwide and topped the charts in several countries. Deacon's ability to create catchy and memorable hooks made him an essential part of Queen's songwriting process.  
  
Throughout his career with Queen, Deacon showcased his versatility as a musician by experimenting with different styles and genres. From the anthemic rock ballad "You're My Best Friend" to the disco-infused "Spread Your Wings," his ability to adapt and create captivating music ensured that Queen's sound remained fresh and innovative throughout the years.  
  
Despite his incredible talent and contribution to Queen's success, Deacon remained a humble and reserved member of the band. Known for his introverted nature, he often stayed out of the spotlight, preferring to let his music speak for itself. This demeanor, coupled with his impeccable skills, made him a beloved figure among fans and his bandmates alike.  
  
Tragedy struck the music world in 1991 with the untimely death of Freddie Mercury due to complications from AIDS. This devastating loss deeply affected Deacon, and he made the difficult decision to step back from the music industry. Unlike his bandmates, Brian May and Roger Taylor, who continued performing under the Queen name with guest vocalists, Deacon chose to retire from the public eye. He released a statement in 1997 explaining his reasons for leaving the music industry, stating that he felt his days as a musician were behind him.  
  
Since then, Deacon has largely remained out of the spotlight and is known for his dedication to privacy. He maintains a low profile, occasionally making public appearances but never returning to the music scene in an official capacity. Despite his absence, his contributions to Queen's legacy and the music industry as a whole are undeniable.  
  
John Deacon's remarkable talent as a musician and songwriter will forever be etched in music history. His ability to create unforgettable basslines and his mastery of songwriting ensured that his impact on Queen's sound remains immeasurable. Though he may have chosen to step away from the public eye, his legacy lives on through the timeless music he created with Queen. John Deacon's influence on the rock genre and his status as one of the greatest bassists of all time is a testament to his unmatched talent and dedication to his craft.

Bizler, Oy ve Ötesi olarak, tamamen gönüllü, sekiz kişilik bağımsız genç bir grup olarak yola koyulduk. Projelerimizi yaparken her zaman siyasi partilerden tamamen bağımsız ve tarafsız olarak hareket ettik. İlk adımımız, 30 Mart yerel seçimlerinde sandıklarımıza sahip çıkmak oldu. Bir avuç insan olarak başlayan hareket 4 ay içerisinde 30.000 gönüllü oldu. 30 Mart 2014 yerel seçimlerinde İstanbul’daki tüm sandıklarda gözlemcilik yaptık ve sayım tutanaklarını topladık. Daha sonra 1 Haziran 2014’te tekrarı gerçekleşen Yalova yerel seçiminde 300’ün üzerinde gönüllümüzle Yalova sandıklarında gözlemcilik yaptık. Bu iki seçim deneyimi, gönüllülerimizin istekliliği, sandık başındaki tecrübeleri ve katılım sayılarının büyüklüğüyle bilrikte, toplum olarak sivil inisiyatif oluşturmaya hazır olduğumuzu gördük. Oy ve Ötesi’nin topluma katkılarından biri de, tarafsız kalarak görüşü birbirinden farklı binlerce insanı bir araya getirmesi ve bu kişilerin beraber nasıl güzel çalışabildiklerini öncelikle kendilerinin, sonra da toplumun deneyimlemesi oldu. Sandığımıza sahip çıkmanın ‘ötesi’nde sivil toplum projeleri yapmanın gerekliliğini de göz ardı etmedik; ismimizi de bu öngörüyle şekillendirmiştik. Ülkemizde geçireceğimiz daha güzel günler için geleceğe katkıda bulunmak misyonuyla yola çıkıp “Ötesi” için 3 farklı alanda proje belirledik ve 24 Nisan 2014 itibariyle Oy ve Ötesi Derneği’ni kurduk. What is the PanFS® parallel file system and how does it benefit users?

About Wescom Credit Union
-------------------------

Banking You Just Can’t Get at a Bank  
In 1934, 13 individuals pooled $65 to create an alternative to the banks.  
Now, with 24 branches and more than $6 billion in assets, Wescom Credit Union has become the essential banking alternative for more than 200,000 members.  
  
Wescom Credit Union is now one of the largest credit unions in the country. A nonprofit financial cooperative, our members are our owners—which means that excess earnings benefit our members, not a small group of shareholders. As a member-owner, you enjoy benefits such as lower loan rates, higher savings yields, reduced fees and an ever-expanding network of branches and ATMs.  
  
Wescom has supported and partnered with UCLA for more than seven years now, and is the Official Banking Partner of UCLA Athletics, UCLA Alumni Association, UCLA Campus Life and Recreation, UCLA Dashew Center for International Students and Scholars, and the Rose Bowl Stadium. Wescom is also an Official Partner of UCLA Financial Wellness Program, UCLA Staff Assembly, and Associated Students of UCLA (ASUCLA).  
  
Friendly, Personal Service  
Wescom’s service is just one of the many things that make us different from the typical banking experience. Whether you come in to our branches, call our Member Contact Center, or visit us online, we go above and beyond to make sure we’re meeting your needs.  
  
How? By offering comprehensive financial services with better rates on everything from deposits to home or auto loans, free online bill paying, investments and financial planning. By developing innovative technology that provides anytime, anywhere account access. By encouraging you to let us know how we're doing, and how we can better meet your needs. And by providing the friendly, personal attention that makes Wescom unique.  
  
It’s Easy To Join  
Anyone in Southern California can open a Wescom Credit Union account. Learn how you can open a new account. We invite you to experience banking you just can’t get at a bank.

Arthur Blank is an American business tycoon who has made an indelible mark on the retail industry and the world of sports. Born on September 27, 1942, in Sunnyside, New York, Blank is best known as the co-founder of The Home Depot, the world's largest home improvement retailer.  
  
Blank pursued his education at Babson College in Wellesley, Massachusetts, where he honed his business acumen and entrepreneurial spirit. After graduating with a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration, he embarked on a career in the retail industry. In 1978, Blank teamed up with fellow entrepreneur Bernie Marcus and founded The Home Depot.  
  
Under Blank's astute leadership and strategic vision, The Home Depot grew from its humble beginnings to a retail powerhouse. His commitment to customer service and emphasis on empowering employees played a pivotal role in the company's success. As President and later as CEO, Blank oversaw the exponential growth of The Home Depot, expanding its reach across the United States and eventually into Mexico and Canada.  
  
Beyond his achievements in the retail sector, Arthur Blank's passion for sports became apparent when he purchased the Atlanta Falcons football team in 2002. Determined to transform the franchise, Blank invested not only in players but also in the fan experience. His openness about his own battle with cancer inspired many and reinforced his reputation as a compassionate and empathetic leader.  
  
In summary, Arthur Blank is a remarkable American businessman who has left an indelible mark on the retail industry and the world of sports. George Benson is an American guitarist and singer-songwriter whose talent and charisma have made him a musical legend. Born and raised in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Benson discovered his love for music at an early age and has since become one of the most influential figures in jazz, soul, and R&B.  
  
Benson's journey in the music industry began in the 1960s when he caught the attention of jazz organist Jack McDuff, who invited him to join his band. It was during this time that Benson honed his skills as a guitarist and gained recognition for his smooth and fluid playing style. His virtuosic abilities on the guitar quickly made him a sought-after musician, and he soon found himself working with jazz greats like Herbie Hancock and Miles Davis.  
  
In the 1970s, Benson made a significant transition in his career as he explored his skills as a singer-songwriter. It was during this period that he released his breakthrough album, "Breezin'," which not only showcased his incredible guitar skills but also highlighted his velvety vocals. The album became a massive commercial success and produced the hit single "This Masquerade," earning Benson his first Grammy Award for Record of the Year. With "Breezin'," Benson seamlessly blended elements of jazz, pop, and R&B, creating a sound that resonated with a broad audience and solidifying his status as a true crossover artist.  
  
Throughout his career, Benson has continually pushed the boundaries of musical genres, effortlessly blending jazz, soul, funk, and pop. One of his signature techniques is scat singing, where he uses his voice as an instrument, improvising melodies and rhythms. This unique approach to singing has become one of his trademarks and further showcases his mastery as a musician.  
  
In addition to his solo success, Benson has collaborated with a variety of artists across different genres. He continues to innovate and evolve as an artist, consistently producing new music that captivates old fans and attracts new ones. About Liz Cheney

Liz Cheney is a prominent figure in American politics, known for her unwavering commitment to conservative principles and her influential position as a former United States Representative. Born into a political family, Cheney has demonstrated both tenacity and intellectual rigour throughout her career, earning her a reputation as a resolute defender of liberty and democratic values.  
  
Cheney's journey into politics began during her formative years, as the daughter of former Vice President of the United States, Dick Cheney. Growing up in a politically charged environment, she developed a deep understanding of the nation's inner workings and its profound impact on the lives of everyday Americans. Inspired by her family's commitment to public service, Liz Cheney forged her own path, focusing on advancing conservative ideology and safeguarding the nation.  
  
A graduate of the University of Chicago and the University of Denver College of Law, Cheney's academic prowess equipped her with the knowledge and skills necessary to excel in the political arena. Following her education, she worked as an attorney and held positions in the U.S. State Department under President George W. Bush, where she gained valuable experience in international relations and national security affairs.  
  
In 2016, Cheney made her political debut when she successfully ran for Wyoming's sole seat in the United States House of Representatives, representing the state's at-large congressional district. Her election marked an important milestone in her career, as she became the first woman to hold this position in Wyoming's history. Passionate about upholding conservative principles, Cheney used her platform to champion limited government, fiscal responsibility, and a strong national defense. She quickly gained recognition as an influential voice in the Republican Party and was elected Chair of the House Republican Conference in 2019, making her the third-highest-ranking Republican in the House of Representatives.  
  
During her time in Congress, Cheney was an outspoken advocate for American exceptionalism and the importance of maintaining a strong national defense. She consistently called for robust military funding, arguing that a strong military is essential for both the nation's security and its standing on the global stage. Cheney's comprehensive understanding of international relations allowed her to navigate complex geopolitical issues with ease and propose effective policies that protected American interests.  
  
Furthermore, Cheney's commitment to safeguarding American values and democracy was particularly evident during the impeachment proceedings against former President Donald Trump in 2019-2021. Despite facing immense pressure within her own party, Cheney stood firmly behind her convictions and voted to impeach Trump for incitement of insurrection following the storming of the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021. Her principled stance demonstrated her unwavering belief in the importance of accountability, regardless of partisan sentiment, and solidified her reputation as a fearless leader unafraid to challenge the status quo.  
  
While Cheney's tenure in Congress was marked by numerous accomplishments, it was not without controversy. Her outspoken criticism of Donald Trump and his role in perpetuating false claims of election fraud and the deadly Capitol riot led to a fracture within the Republican Party itself. Despite facing backlash from fellow Republicans and ultimately being removed from her leadership role, Cheney remained steadfast in her beliefs, vowing to continue fighting for truth, constitutional principles, and the future of the Republican Party.  
  
Beyond her political career, Liz Cheney is a devoted wife and mother. Married to attorney Philip Perry, with whom she has five children, Cheney is known for her ability to balance her personal and professional life effectively. Her dedication to her family serves as a testament to her prioritization of traditional conservative values and reinforces her understanding of the everyday concerns and aspirations of the American people.  
  
In conclusion, Liz Cheney's impact on American politics cannot be overstated. Her unwavering commitment to conservative principles, her fearless defense of American democracy, and her exceptional leadership skills have positioned her as a prominent figure in the Republican Party. Cheney's journey from a politically influential family to becoming the first woman to represent Wyoming in Congress reflects her determination to uphold conservative values while promoting bipartisan dialogue. Regardless of the challenges she faces, Liz Cheney's unwavering dedication to her convictions ensures that her influence will continue to shape the course of American politics for years to come.

Mason County PUD No. 3 provides electricity to nearly 33,000 customers in most of Mason County and small portions of Kitsap, Grays Harbor, and Pierce Counties. PUD 3 is headquartered in Shelton, Washington and has an office in Belfair. The PUD has been in business since 1939.  
  
PUD 3 owns and operates 11 substations and has over 1,800 miles of overhead and underground lines to serve its customers (1,074 miles underground, 686 miles overhead).  
  
The PUD also provides wholesale telecommunications services to its customers through a fiber optic network.  
  
• PUD 3 has 115 full-time-equivalent positions.  
• 2012 adopted budget: $57 million.  
• 2011 electricity sales were 669,925,701 kWh.  
• Average load is 80 megawatts.  
• Peak load is 160 megawatts.  
  
Mason County PUD No. 3 is a municipal corporation operating under Washington State Law (RCW 54). Public utility districts were authorized by the first citizens’ initiative in the state. There are 28 public utility districts in the state, providing nearly half of the state’s electricity customers with service.

About Surface Oncology Inc.
---------------------------

Surface Oncology is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company focused on using its specialized knowledge of the biological pathways critical to the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) for the development of next-generation therapies to help patients suffering with cancer. Recent advances in understanding how the immune system fights cancer has created a first wave of immunotherapies with profound benefits for some patients. These first-generation therapies, or "checkpoint inhibitors", have been groundbreaking, but only a relatively small subset of patients is deriving long-term benefit. We believe that the lack of a broad and sustained clinical response is because these first-generation therapies only target one component of the immunosuppressive TME and a broader, more multi-faceted therapeutic approach is required.  
We are a team on a mission to deliver transformative outcomes for people with cancer by breaking through the frontiers of immuno-oncology research. Our diverse clinical and preclinical pipeline of immune-enhancing antibody candidates target the innate and adaptive arms of the immune system to deliver dramatically different therapies for patients and their families.  
Surface is leveraging its deep understanding of TME biology to target factors and cells that suppress patients’ anti-tumor immune response. Our broad attack on the TME has the potential to convert patients’ non-responsive ‘cold’ tumors into immune-active ones. We push ourselves to break through across all dimensions of our work.  
From a discovery perspective, Surface leverages its world-class SAB to identify new targets and takes an aggressive approach towards generating diverse, highly-specific antibodies, which allows our scientists to thoroughly explore the relevant biology. Our antibody discovery approach generates therapeutic-quality antibodies, as well as unique tools to explore the biology of the tumor microenvironment.

James Altucher is an American author, podcaster, and entrepreneur who has made a name for himself through his unconventional and thought-provoking ideas. With a career spanning various industries, Altucher has gained a reputation as a renegade voice in the world of self-help and personal development. He challenges traditional notions of success, encouraging his followers to embrace failure, reject societal expectations, and foster creativity. Altucher's unique blend of wit, wisdom, and vulnerability has resonated with millions of listeners and readers around the globe.  
  
Born in New York City in 1968, Altucher's early life was far from glamorous. Despite attending the prestigious Horace Mann School, he struggled with depression and feelings of inadequacy that followed him into adulthood. However, he refused to let these setbacks define him. Instead, Altucher embarked on a journey of self-discovery, exploring various career paths and becoming a true Renaissance man.  
  
Altucher's literary career kickstarted in the early 2000s with the release of several books, including "Trade Like a Hedge Fund" and "Trade Like Warren Buffett." These works reflected his expertise in the world of finance and investment, which he gained during his time as a hedge fund manager. However, Altucher's break came in 2011 with the release of "Choose Yourself!," a self-published book that quickly became a viral sensation. In this book, Altucher shared the unconventional wisdom he had acquired throughout his life, encouraging readers to disregard societal expectations and embrace their own path to success and happiness.  
  
For Altucher, failure played a pivotal role in shaping his journey. In fact, he proudly wears the badge of being a "professional failure," claiming to have had countless business failures, failed relationships, and personal struggles. However, it is through these experiences that he has gained wisdom and a unique perspective on life. Through his writings, Altucher shares his stories of failure openly and honestly, in pursuit of helping others find their own paths to success and happiness.  
  
Beyond writing, Altucher has also made a name for himself in the podcasting world. With his popular show, "The James Altucher Show," he interviews a diverse range of guests, including entrepreneurs, artists, and thought leaders. The show provides a platform for these individuals to share their experiences and insights, offering listeners a well-rounded perspective on success and personal growth.  
  
What sets Altucher apart from other self-help authors and podcasters is his unfiltered approach. He challenges conventional wisdom and encourages his followers to reject societal norms and carve out their own paths. Altucher believes that success is not about achieving external milestones, such as wealth and fame. Instead, he emphasizes the importance of personal fulfillment, authenticity, and cultivating one's own unique talents and passions.  
  
In addition to his self-help work, Altucher is an active investor in various industries, including technology, finance, and publishing. He has founded or co-founded multiple companies, including StockPickr and Reset Inc., which reflect his expertise in the fields of finance and technology. Altucher's entrepreneurial spirit and ability to embrace uncertainty have allowed him to succeed across different ventures, further solidifying his status as a multi-dimensional figure.  
  
James Altucher is undoubtedly a polarizing figure in the self-help and personal development space. His unconventional approach and willingness to speak openly about his own failures have gained him a loyal following of followers who appreciate his honest and relatable message. Through his books, podcast, and entrepreneurial ventures, Altucher continues to inspire and challenge individuals to redefine success and live life on their own terms.

Loan sizes for single assets are between $5MM-$50MM+ and portfolio loans are available up to $200MM. A10 Capital will lend in a variety of markets and property types.  
  
The Company’s platform is primarily in-house—beginning at origination, through the underwriting/closing process, and is serviced internally throughout the life of the loan. A10 is headquartered in Boise, Idaho, with regional offices throughout the United States. For more information, please visit us at www.A10Capital.com.

AC Martin is a California-based architecture, planning, interior architecture and research firm that uses an integrated design approach to create enduring environments for the 21st century.  
  
Albert C. Martin, Sr. founded our firm over 100 years ago with a dream to grow the city of Los Angeles into a thriving, vital community. When he started in 1906, LA County was only 100,000 people strong. Today, LA is one of the most culturally diverse centers of commerce in the nation with close to 13 million people.  
  
As we look back on over a century of practice, AC Martin's values remain with us. He was a visionary and a consummate professional who believed in serving his clients, and his community. His goal was to make the world a better place. Today, that remains our commitment, and our responsibility.  
  
Our vision at AC Martin is to create enduring environments that affect people’s lives in a positive way. For us, that means creating landmark environments that are user-focused, innovative, sustainable and beautiful. We design inspiring projects that respond to social, cultural, environmental and technical challenges in unique ways. We’ve been passionate about craftsmanship since the beginning.

This can not only bring a cost reduction of up to 40%, but means your key team members are freed from manual tasks and can maximise their value to the business.  
  
If you’d like to find out more, get in touch by visiting: www.sksbusinessservices.com.

About Tito Jackson

Tito Jackson is an American musician renowned for his contribution to the iconic Jackson 5, one of the most successful groups in the history of popular music. As a member of this legendary family band, Tito played a vital role in shaping the sound that captivated the hearts of millions of fans across the globe. Born on October 15, 1953, in Gary, Indiana, Tito first discovered his passion for music under the guidance of his father, Joseph Jackson.  
  
Tito began his musical journey at a young age, picking up the guitar and refining his skills alongside his brothers Jackie, Jermaine, Marlon, and Michael. They soon became local sensations, captivating audiences with their extraordinary talent and tight harmonies. In 1969, the group signed with Motown Records, and thus began their meteoric rise to stardom. The harmonious blend of Tito's guitar riffs and the energetic performances by the Jackson 5 catapulted the group to the top of the charts, with hit after hit dominating the airwaves.  
  
Throughout his career, Tito's musicianship and creative contributions were vital in developing the distinct sound of the Jackson 5. His guitar playing infused their music with a unique blend of soul, funk, and R&B, setting them apart from other artists of the time. Tito's signature guitar riffs can be heard in many of the group's biggest hits, such as "I Want You Back," "ABC," and "Never Can Say Goodbye." His skillful playing created a melodic backdrop that complemented the powerful vocals of his brothers, helping to define the sound of Motown during its golden era.  
  
Tito's contributions extended beyond his musical abilities, as he played a significant role in the Jackson 5's performances. His charismatic stage presence and infectious energy lit up the stage, captivating audiences around the world. Tito's charisma was especially noticeable during live performances, where his intricate dance moves perfectly synchronized with his guitar playing, creating an electrifying atmosphere. As a member of the Jackson 5, Tito laid the foundation for what would later become the iconic Jackson family legacy.  
  
After leaving the Jackson 5 in 1984, Tito embarked on a solo career, evolving as an artist and exploring new musical horizons. He released his debut solo album, "Tito Time," in 2016, which showcased his evolution as a musician and songwriter. The album features a diverse range of musical styles, including R&B, pop, and soul, with Tito seamlessly blending his guitar skills with infectious melodies and heartfelt lyrics. "Tito Time" received critical acclaim, solidifying Tito's status as a talented solo artist with a unique voice.  
  
Alongside his solo career, Tito remains an integral part of the Jackson family's musical legacy. He continues to collaborate with family members, bringing their unique blend of harmonies to audiences worldwide. Tito's willingness to adapt and evolve as a musician has allowed him to remain relevant throughout the decades, always pushing musical boundaries and exploring new creative avenues.  
  
Tito Jackson's impact on the music industry cannot be overstated. His guitar skills, infectious energy, and charismatic stage presence have left an indelible mark on popular music. As a member of the Jackson 5, he helped shape the sound of Motown in its golden era, and as a solo artist, he continues to explore new musical territories. Tito's timeless contributions to music will forever be celebrated, ensuring his presence in the annals of music history for generations to come.

Lori Otis is a dedicated occupational therapist specializing in early intervention therapy for children with developmental delays, particularly focusing on sensory integration processing disorders. Her experience in rehabilitation and clinical research informs her practice, allowing her to stay at the forefront of innovative treatment methodologies.

About Agence Française de Développement
---------------------------------------

Établissement public, l’Agence Française de Développement (AFD) agit depuis soixante-dix ans pour combattre la pauvreté et favoriser le développement dans les pays du Sud et dans l’Outre-mer. Elle met en œuvre la politique définie par le Gouvernement français.  
  
Présente sur quatre continents où elle dispose d'un réseau de 70 agences et bureaux de représentation dans le monde, dont 9 dans l'Outre-mer et 1 à Bruxelles, l’AFD finance et accompagne des projets qui améliorent les conditions de vie des populations, soutiennent la croissance économique et protègent la planète : scolarisation, santé maternelle, appui aux agriculteurs et aux petites entreprises, adduction d’eau, préservation de la forêt tropicale, lutte contre le réchauffement climatique…  
  
En 2012, l’AFD a consacré plus de 6,9 milliards d’euros au financement d’actions dans les pays en développement et en faveur de l’Outre-mer. Ils contribueront notamment à la scolarisation de 10 millions d’enfants au niveau primaire et de 3 millions au niveau collège, et à l’amélioration de l’approvisionnement en eau potable pour 1,79 million de personnes. Les projets d’efficacité énergétique sur la même année permettront d’économiser près de 3,6 millions de tonnes d’équivalent CO2 par an.

About Pizza Hut France
----------------------

PIZZA HUT : trop bon, trop hut !  
  
Implantée en France depuis 1987, Pizza Hut fait partie du groupe Yum!, leader mondial dans le secteur de la restauration.  
  
NOS PRODUITS :  
L’originalité du concept tient dans la variété des recettes de pâte que la marque a développées : les clients peuvent choisir entre la pâte classique, la « pan » ou la « cheezy crust » fourrée au fromage.  
Les légumes sont essentiels au bon goût de nos pizzas. Tomates rouges et juteuses, poivrons vers et charnus - tous les légumes sont hachés tous les jours.  
  
NOS STANDARDS :  
PIZZA HUT a toujours mis l’accent sur l’innovation en matière de produits (Cheezy Crust Fun, La Box,...) mais aussi de service (site de commandes en ligne utilisable avec n'importe quel smartphone et tablette,...)  
  
En 2017, AmRest rachète la master Franchise de Pizza Hut en France.  
  
Le concept correspond parfaitement aux nouveaux modes de vie des Français. La livraison à domicile et la vente à emporter s’imposent auprès des consommateurs, qui passent de moins en moins de temps à faire la cuisine.  
PIZZA HUT anime un réseau de 148 restaurants en France.  
  
Aujourd'hui, dans le monde, PIZZA HUT représente plus de 18 000 points de vente dans 104 pays.  
  
Rejoignez nous !

About TG Therapeutics
---------------------

TG Therapeutics is an innovative, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of medically important pharmaceutical products for the treatment of cancer and other underserved therapeutic needs. Currently, the company is developing two therapies targeting hematological malignancies. TG-1101 (ublituximab) is a novel, glycoengineered, third generation monoclonal antibody that targets a specific and unique epitope on the CD20 antigen found on mature B-lymphocytes. TG Therapeutics is also developing TGR-1202, an orally available PI3K delta inhibitor. The delta isoform of PI3K is strongly expressed in cells of hematopoietic origin and is believed to be important in the proliferation and survival of B-lymphocytes. Both TG-1101 and TGR-1202 are in clinical development for patients with hematologic malignancies. TG Therapeutics is headquartered in New York City and is traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol "TGTX".

It manages approximately 100 property projects in 11 cities with a total service area of 26.16 million sq.m.  
In the next 10 to15 years, its vision is to become the most respected and trusted market leader in the industry. It will continue to provide quality products and services for clients and influence their behaviors, as well as become an excellent company and create new opportunities.

Mizco supports various industries related to consumer electronics, including retail, telecommunications, and e-commerce. Their products are used by businesses that sell mobile devices and accessories, as well as those involved in technology and electronics distribution.
